abandon.definition:
n. the trait of lacking restraint or control; reckless freedom from inhibition or worry
v. forsake, leave behind
v. give up with the intent of never claiming again
v. stop maintaining or insisting on; of ideas or claims
abandon.translation: vt. 放弃, 抛弃, 遗弃, 使屈从, 沉溺, 放纵\nn. 放任, 无拘束, 狂热

examples.en: We have to abandon the plan.
examples.zh: 我们必须放弃这个计划。

examples.en: He abandoned his family and moved to Tahiti.
examples.zh: 他抛弃了家人，移居大溪地。

examples.en: Kenji abandoned his hope of becoming a doctor.
examples.zh: 健二放弃了成为医生的希望。

abbreviation.definition: n. a shortened form of a word or phrase\nn. shortening something by omitting parts of it
abbreviation.translation: n. 缩写词, 缩写, 缩短, 节略

examples.en: The abbreviation of "Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference" is "CPPCC".
examples.zh: “中国人民政治协商会议”的简称是“人民政协”。

examples.en: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom.
examples.zh: UK是英国的缩写。

examples.en: Please memorise these abbreviations.
examples.zh: 请记住这些缩写。

abide.definition: v dwell\nv put up with something or somebody unpleasant
abide.translation: vi. 停留, 遵守, 居留, 继续下去\nvt. 忍受, 经受, 屈从于

examples.en: My parents teach me to abide by my promises.
examples.zh: 父母教育我要遵守承诺。

examples.en: You have to abide by the laws.
examples.zh: 你必须遵守法律。

examples.en: We have to abide by the rules.
examples.zh: 我们必须遵守规则。

ability.definition: n. the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment\nn. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
ability.translation: n. 能力, 才干\n[经] 能力, 才能

examples.en: I will help him to the best of my ability.
examples.zh: 我将会尽我所能地帮助他。

examples.en: My boss has the ability to read books very fast.
examples.zh: 我的老板看书可以看得很快。

examples.en: He had lost all faith in his ability to succeed.
examples.zh: 他完全丧失了能成功的信心。

able.definition:
a. (usually followed by `to') having the necessary means or skill or know-how or authority to do something
s. have the skills and qualifications to do things well
s. having inherent physical or mental ability or capacity
s. having a strong healthy body
able.translation: a. 能干的, 能够的

examples.en: He is able to do it better than I am.
examples.zh: 他有能力比我做得更好。

examples.en: I hope we will be able to keep in touch.
examples.zh: 希望我们能够保持联络吧。

examples.en: I'm glad I was able to be useful to you.
examples.zh: 我很高兴我能帮助到你。

abnormal.definition: a. not normal; not typical or usual or regular or conforming to a norm\na. departing from the normal in e.g. intelligence and development\ns. much greater than the normal
abnormal.translation: a. 反常的, 不规则的, 变态的, 畸形的\nn. 畸形的人

examples.en: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
examples.zh: 环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。

examples.en: His view on marriage is abnormal.
examples.zh: 他的婚姻观很畸形。

aboard.definition:
r. on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle
r. on first or second or third base
r. side by side
r. part of a group
aboard.translation: adv. 在船上, 在火车上, 在飞机上\nprep. 在...之上

examples.en: How many people were aboard that ship?
examples.zh: 那艘船上有多少人？

examples.en: The passengers all went aboard the ship.
examples.zh: 乘客全都登上了船。

examples.en: It is very dangerous to jump aboard the train when it is moving.
examples.zh: 跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。

abolish.translation: vt. 废止, 革除, 消灭\n[经] 废除, 取消, 裁撤

examples.en: We should abolish the death penalty.
examples.zh: 我们应该废除死刑。

examples.en: How can we abolish war?
examples.zh: 我们怎样才能停止战争？

examples.en: Many countries have abolished capital punishment.
examples.zh: 许多国家已经废除了死刑。

abortion.translation: n. 流产, 堕胎, 失败, 夭折, 中止\n[医] 流产, 小产; 顿挫

examples.en: Are you for or against abortion?
examples.zh: 你支持还是反对堕胎？

examples.en: Do you support or oppose abortion?
examples.zh: 你支持还是反对堕胎？

examples.en: Are you for or against abortions?
examples.zh: 你支持还是反对堕胎？

about.definition:
s. on the move
r. all around or on all sides
r. in the area or vicinity
r. used of movement to or among many different places or in no particular direction
about.translation: prep. 在...周围, 大约, 有关, 关于\nadv. 大约, 四处, 在附近, 周围

examples.en: Only a shoe knows about a hole in a sock.
examples.zh: 只有鞋子知道袜子的洞。

examples.en: I was about to go out when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正要出门的时候，电话就响起了。

examples.en: We went to the café that I told you about.
examples.zh: 我们去了我告诉过你的那家咖啡店。

above.definition:
n. an earlier section of a written text
s. appearing earlier in the same text
r. at an earlier place
r. in or to a place that is higher
above.translation: prep. 在上方, 超出\nadv. 在上面\na. 上述的, 上面的

examples.en: He likes to watch the birds fly above his head.
examples.zh: 他喜欢看着鸟儿从头上飞过。

examples.en: Jim is above any of his classmates in English.
examples.zh: 杰米的英语比他班上任何一个同学的都好。

examples.en: Above all, you must take good care of yourself.
examples.zh: 最重要的是你要好好照顾自己。

abroad.definition: s. in a foreign country\nr. to or in a foreign country
abroad.translation: adv. 往国外, 到室外, 到处\na. 往国外的, 在室外的, 广泛四散的

examples.en: She spends a lot of money when she goes abroad.
examples.zh: 她出国的时候花销很大。

examples.en: She studied abroad in order to brush up her English.
examples.zh: 她在国外学习以便提升她的英语。

examples.en: My wife often called me when I was travelling abroad.
examples.zh: 我在国外旅行的时候，我老婆老给我打电话。

abrupt.definition:
s. marked by sudden changes in subject and sharp transitions
s. exceedingly sudden and unexpected
s. extremely steep
s. surprisingly and unceremoniously brusque in manner
abrupt.translation: a. 突然的, 唐突的, 陡峭的, 不连贯的

examples.en: His wonderful life came to an abrupt and tragic end.
He is abrupt, but is, in fact, a good-natured person.
The road made an abrupt transition from concrete to gravel.

absence.definition:
n. the state of being absent
n. failure to be present
n. the time interval during which something or somebody is away
n. the occurrence of an abrupt, transient loss or impairment of consciousness (which is not subsequently remembered), sometimes with light twitching, fluttering eyelids, etc.; common in petit mal epilepsy
absence.translation: n. 缺席, 缺乏, 没有\n[医] 失神

examples.en: Her absence went unnoticed until the end of the meeting.
examples.zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

examples.en: His absence gave birth to all sorts of rumors.
examples.zh: 他的缺席导致了各种谣言的产生。

examples.en: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.
examples.zh: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

absent.definition: v. go away or leave\na. not being in a specified place\ns. lost in thought; showing preoccupation
absent.translation: a. 缺席的, 不在的, 缺乏的, 漫不经心的\nvt. 使缺席

examples.en: The boy has been absent from school for eight days.
examples.zh: 那个男孩已经有八天没上学了。

examples.en: Why do you think Tom and Mary were absent yesterday?
examples.zh: 你认为汤姆和玛丽昨天为什么缺席了？。

examples.en: He was absent from school yesterday because he was ill.
examples.zh: 他昨天没来上学，因为他病了。

absolute.definition:
n. something that is conceived or that exists independently and not in relation to other things; something that does not depend on anything else and is beyond human control; something that is not relative
a. perfect or complete or pure
s. complete and without restriction or qualification; sometimes used informally as intensifiers
s. not limited by law
absolute.translation: a. 绝对的, 专制的, 完全的, 独立的\nn. 绝对事物

examples.en: What country has the absolute advantage in the production of corn?
examples.zh: 哪一个国家拥有生产玉米的绝对优势？

examples.en: The lord held absolute power over his subjects.
examples.zh: 领主对他的臣民有绝对权力。

examples.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
examples.zh: 电脑现在是一个绝对必要的东西了。

absolutely.definition: r. completely and without qualification; used informally as intensifiers\nr. totally and definitely; without question
absolutely.translation: adv. 完全地, 绝对地, 确确实实地

examples.en: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.
examples.zh: 让我像这样继续下去是绝对不可能的。

examples.en: This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
examples.zh: 这个故事听起来可能很奇怪，但却是千真万确的。

examples.en: Tom said that he was absolutely sure Mary would do that.
examples.zh: 汤姆说，他完全肯定玛莉会那样做。

absorb.definition:
v. become imbued
v. take up mentally
v. take up, as of debts or payments
v. take in, also metaphorically
absorb.translation: vt. 吸收, 使全神贯注, 同化, 买进, 理解, 承受, 忍受, 承担\n[医] 吸收

examples.en: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an hour.
examples.zh: 我不能一小时内彻底的了解那堂课程。

examples.en: It feels like it's going to absorb you into another world.
examples.zh: 它的感觉像是它把你吸到了另外一个世界。

examples.en: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 树木排出氧气，吸收二氧化碳。

abstract.definition:
v. consider a concept without thinking of a specific example; consider abstractly or theoretically
v. consider apart from a particular case or instance
v. give an abstract (of)
a. existing only in the mind; separated from embodiment
abstract.translation:
a. 抽象的, 深奥的
n. 摘要, 抽象概念
vt. 摘要, 提炼, 使抽象化
[计] 摘录; 摘要; 抽象

examples.en: I made an abstract of a book.
examples.zh: 我为一本书写了内容提要。

examples.en: Some abstract art is difficult to understand.
examples.zh: 一些抽象艺术是很难理解的。

examples.en: To him, hunger was an abstract concept; he always had enough to eat.
examples.zh: 对他来说，「肚子饿」是个抽象的概念，因为他从来就没有饿过。

absurd.definition: n. a situation in which life seems irrational and meaningless\ns. inconsistent with reason or logic or common sense\ns. incongruous; inviting ridicule
absurd.translation: a. 荒谬的, 不合理的, 可笑的\nn. 荒诞

examples.en: The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
examples.zh: 永动机这个概念是个荒唐的假说。

examples.en: It is absurd of you to do that.
examples.zh: 你那么做真是太过荒谬了.

examples.en: I think that this is all quite absurd.
examples.zh: 这一切在我看来都颇为荒唐。

abundance.definition: n. the property of a more than adequate quantity or supply\nn. (physics) the ratio of the number of atoms of a specific isotope of an element to the total number of isotopes present\nn. (chemistry) the ratio of the total mass of an element in the earth's crust to the total mass of the earth's crust; expressed as a percentage or in parts per million
abundance.translation: n. 丰富, 充足, 大量\n[经] 丰富, 充裕

examples.en: She lives in abundance.
examples.zh: 她过着富足的日子。

examples.en: I prefer traditional characters. Due to the abundance of reading materials in simplified characters, I can recognize many of them too.
examples.zh: 我偏爱繁体字。因为有大量的简体字的阅读材料，我也认识很多简体字。

abundant.translation: a. 丰富的, 充分的, 大量的

examples.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
examples.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。

examples.en: There is an abundant supply of foodstuffs.
examples.zh: 粮食供应十分充足。

examples.en: These fields yield an abundant harvest.
examples.zh: 这些田有很多收获。

abuse.definition: n. a rude expression intended to offend or hurt\nv. use foul or abusive language towards\nv. use wrongly or improperly or excessively
abuse.translation: n. 滥用, 虐待, 恶习, 辱骂\nvt. 滥用, 辱骂, 虐待

examples.en: We can only abuse of things that are good.
examples.zh: 我们只能滥用善良的。

examples.en: How long, O Catiline, will you abuse our patience?
examples.zh: 喀提林，你还会滥用我们的耐心多久呀？

examples.en: Tom has a long history of drug abuse.
examples.zh: 汤姆有长期滥用药物的历史。

academic.definition: a. associated with academia or an academy\ns. hypothetical or theoretical and not expected to produce an immediate or practical result\ns. marked by a narrow focus on or display of learning especially its trivial aspects
academic.translation: a. 学院的, 学术的, 不切实际的\nn. 大学生, 大学教师, 学者, 学会会员

examples.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
examples.zh: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。

examples.en: Schoolwork, cultural work and academic work should all be promoted together.
examples.zh: 学生工作、文化工作和学术工作应该同时推进。

academy.definition:
n. a secondary school (usually private)
n. an institution for the advancement of art or science or literature
n. a school for special training
n. a learned establishment for the advancement of knowledge
academy.translation: n. 学院, 院校, 学会

examples.en: The results of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' survey are like this.
examples.zh: 中国科学院的调查结果是这样的。

examples.en: The military treatise authored by Sun Tzu is, to this day, required reading in military academies all across the world.
examples.zh: 孙子所著的兵法，至今仍是各国军事学院的必读经典。

examples.en: I am Du Yu, a student at the Faculty of Computer Science and Technology, Qilu University of Technology (Shandong Academy of Sciences).
examples.zh: 我是杜宇，是一名来自齐鲁工业大学（山东省科学院）计算机科学与技术学部的学生。

accelerate.definition: v. move faster\nv. cause to move faster

examples.en: The car continued to accelerate.
examples.zh: 车子继续加速。

accent.definition: n. distinctive manner of oral expression\nn. a diacritical mark used to indicate stress or placed above a vowel to indicate a special pronunciation
accent.translation: n. 重音, 口音, 特点, 注重点\nvt. 重读, 加重音号于, 强调

examples.en: The accent in "guitar" falls on the second syllable.
examples.zh: 「Guitar」一字的重音在第二音节。

examples.en: He spoke with a Taiwanese accent mixed in.
examples.zh: 他说话夹杂著台湾口音。

examples.en: Where is the accent on the word 'Australia?'
examples.zh: “Australia”这个词的重音要放在哪？

accept.definition:
v. consider or hold as true
v. receive willingly something given or offered
v. give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to
v. react favorably to; consider right and proper
accept.translation: vt. 接受, 承认, 同意, 相信, 赞成, 承担, 承兑, 采纳, 接纳, 容忍\nvi. 同意

examples.en: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.
examples.zh: 我不知道是否该同意或拒绝。

examples.en: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。

examples.en: I had no choice but to accept the offer.
examples.zh: 除了接受报价，我别无选择。

acceptable.definition: a. worthy of acceptance or satisfactory\ns. judged to be in conformity with approved usage\ns. adequate for the purpose
acceptable.translation: a. 可接受的, 合意的, 可忍受的

examples.en: There's a fine line between what's acceptable and what's not.
The solution which was suggested was acceptable to all parties.
Acceptable and unacceptable are clearly in opposition to each other.

acceptance.definition:
n. the state of being acceptable and accepted
n. (contract law) words signifying consent to the terms of an offer (thereby creating a contract)
n. banking: a time draft drawn on and accepted by a bank
n. the act of taking something that is offered
acceptance.translation: n. 接受, 接纳, 承认, 同意, 赞同, 容忍, 相信\n[经] 承兑, 认付, (工程)验收

examples.en: She thanked her mentors during her service award acceptance speech.
Reading this sentence constitutes acceptance of its Terms and Conditions.
Reading this sentence constitutes acceptance of its terms and conditions.

access.definition:
n. the right to obtain or make use of or take advantage of something (as services or membership)
n. a way of entering or leaving
n. a code (a series of characters or digits) that must be entered in some way (typed or dialed or spoken) to get the use of something (a telephone line or a computer or a local area network etc.)
n. (computer science) the operation of reading or writing stored information
access.translation: n. 通路, 入口, 接近, 进入, 使用权, 发作\nvt. 访问, 存取, 接近, 使用\n[计] 访问, 存取

examples.en: The only access to the village is from the river.
examples.zh: 去那个村庄的唯一途径是过河。

examples.en: The burglar gained access to the house through this door.
examples.zh: 窃贼是从这扇门进到屋子里的。

examples.en: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.
examples.zh: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。

accessible.definition:
a. capable of being reached
s. capable of being read with comprehension
s. easily obtained
s. easy to get along with or talk to; friendly
accessible.translation: a. 易接近的, 可进入的, 可使用的, 易受影响的, 可理解的

examples.en: Those records are not accessible to the public.
examples.zh: 这些记录不对公众开放。

examples.en: New York is accessible by train from Washington.
examples.zh: 从华盛顿乘火车可以到纽约。

accident.definition: n. an unfortunate mishap; especially one causing damage or injury\nn. anything that happens suddenly or by chance without an apparent cause
accident.translation: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面\n[化] 意外事故; 事故

examples.en: It is no use blaming him for the accident now.
examples.zh: 事情已经发生了，现在怪他也没有用。

examples.en: I was late for school on account of an accident.
examples.zh: 因为一起事故，我上学迟到了。

examples.en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
examples.zh: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。

accidental.definition: n. a musical notation that makes a note sharp or flat or natural although that is not part of the key signature\ns. happening by chance or unexpectedly or unintentionally
accidental.translation: a. 意外的, 偶然的, 非主要的, 附属的\nn. 临时记号, 次要方面

examples.en: That discovery was quite accidental.
examples.zh: 那个发现纯属偶然。

accommodate.definition: v. provide with something desired or needed\nv. have room for; hold without crowding\nv. make (one thing) compatible with (another)
accommodate.translation: vt. 使适应, 调和, 通融, 容纳, 向...提供\nvi. 适应

examples.en: The motel can accommodate as many as 400 guests.
examples.zh: 汽车旅馆可以接待多达400名客人。

examples.en: This classroom can accommodate only thirty students.
examples.zh: 这间班房只能容纳三十个学生。

accommodation.definition:
n. a settlement of differences
n. in the theories of Jean Piaget: the modification of internal representations in order to accommodate a changing knowledge of reality
n. living quarters provided for public convenience
n. the act of providing something (lodging or seat or food) to meet a need
accommodation.translation: n. 膳宿, 预订铺位, 适应性调节, 调和, 贷款\n[医] 调节(眼); 适应

examples.en: Do you offer accommodation?
examples.zh: 您提供住宿吗？

examples.en: This hotel has accommodations for 1,000 guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店可以容纳一千人。

accompany.definition: v. go or travel along with
accompany.translation: vt. 陪伴, 伴随, 补充, 为...伴奏\nvi. 伴奏, 伴唱

examples.en: Mademoiselle, would you like a platinum necklace to accompany your ring?
examples.zh: 小姐已经有一个戒指，要不要配一条铂金项链？

examples.en: She will accompany me on the piano.
examples.zh: 她会弹钢琴为我伴奏。

examples.en: She was told to accompany me.
examples.zh: 有人叫她陪我。

accomplish.definition: v put in effect\nv to gain with effort
accomplish.translation: vt. 完成, 达到, 实现, 使完美

examples.en: He is sure to accomplish his purpose.
examples.zh: 他很肯定可以达到目标。

examples.en: Without me, you wouldn't accomplish anything.
examples.zh: 如果没有我，你什么也做不到。

examples.en: Did you accomplish the task?
examples.zh: 你成功完成任务了吗？

accomplishment.definition: n. the action of accomplishing something

examples.en: "She would never judge her own accomplishments, but she has succeeded in achieving what she set out to do in her first year," the source said.
examples.zh: 知情者说，“她从来不会评判自己的成就，但是她成功地做好了她第一年决心做的事。”

accord.definition: n. concurrence of opinion\nn. sympathetic compatibility\nv. allow to have
accord.translation: n. 一致, 调和, 协定\nvt. 给与, 使一致\nvi. 相符合

examples.en: The story is not in accord with the facts.
examples.zh: 这个故事与事实不符。

examples.en: I chose this dictionary of my own accord.
examples.zh: 这本词典是我自己选的。

examples.en: This measure is in accord with our policy.
examples.zh: 这个议案合符我们的政策内容。

accordance.definition: n. the act of granting rights

examples.en: I will sell the boat in accordance with your orders.
We played the game in accordance with the new rules.
In accordance with his advice, I called off the deal.

according.definition: s. (followed by `to') in agreement with or accordant with\ns. (followed by `to') as reported or stated by
according.translation: a. 相符的, 根据...而定的\nadv. 相应地

examples.en: According to the weather forecast, it's supposed to snow tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪。

examples.en: According to the coach, Bob is a good swimmer.
examples.zh: 教练说，鲍伯游泳游得很好。

examples.en: According to TV news, there was a plane crash in India.
examples.zh: 根据电视新闻，一架飞机在印度坠毁了。

accordingly.translation: adv. 相应地, 因此, 于是

examples.en: Accordingly, besides noun declension patterns, there also existed a greater variety of verb conjugation patterns than in Modern English.
examples.zh: 因此，除了名词的变格之外，也存在比现代英语多的动词的各种变型。

account.definition:
n. a formal contractual relationship established to provide for regular banking or brokerage or business services
n. importance or value
n. a statement of recent transactions and the resulting balance
n. the quality of taking advantage
account.translation:
n. 报告, 解释, 估价, 理由, 利润, 算账, 帐目
vi. 报帐, 解释, 导致, 报偿, 占, 杀死
vt. 认为
[计] 帐户, 帐号

examples.en: The game was called off on account of the rain.
examples.zh: 比赛因为下雨取消了。

examples.en: I was late for school on account of an accident.
examples.zh: 因为一起事故，我上学迟到了。

examples.en: The article begins with an account of the current situation.
examples.zh: 文章开头讲了当前的形势。

accountant.definition: n. someone who maintains and audits business accounts
accountant.translation: n. 会计人员, 会计师\n[经] 会计师, 会计人员

examples.en: Allan was lucky and passed the tax accountant examination.
examples.zh: 艾伦很幸运地考过了税务师考试。

examples.en: Tom is an accountant.
examples.zh: 汤姆是个会计师。

examples.en: Tom has accumulated a lot of junk.
examples.zh: 汤姆屯了很多垃圾。

examples.en: Dust had accumulated in the attic.
examples.zh: 阁楼上积了灰。

accuracy.definition: n. the quality of being near to the true value\nn. (mathematics) the number of significant figures given in a number
accuracy.translation: n. 精确, 正确\n[计] 准确度

examples.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
examples.zh: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。

examples.en: There's no need to worry about accuracy this time; just eyeball it.
examples.zh: 现在精确度已经不重要了，你目测一下就好。

examples.en: Let's not mistake precision for accuracy.
examples.zh: 不要把精确和准确搞错。

accurate.definition: a. conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy\ns. (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth; strictly correct
accurate.translation: a. 正确的, 精确的\n[经] 准确的, 精确的

examples.en: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.
examples.zh: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。

examples.en: It's not your mother tongue, so your pronunciation will never be accurate.
examples.zh: 因为它不是你的母语，你的发音会永远不准。

examples.en: My Danish pronunciation is not very accurate.
examples.zh: 我的丹麦语发音不是很标准。

accuse.definition: v. bring an accusation against; level a charge against
accuse.translation: vt. 指责, 控告, 归咎于\nvi. 指责, 控告

examples.en: You can't accuse him of theft without having proof.
examples.zh: 没有证据你们不能指责他偷东西。

examples.en: The accused is to appear before the court on Friday.
examples.zh: 被告周五将会出现在法庭上。

examples.en: They accused him of being part of the plot.
examples.zh: 人们指控他参与了这场阴谋。

accustomed.definition: a. (often followed by `to') in the habit of or adapted to\ns. commonly used or practiced; usual
accustomed.translation: a. 惯常的, 习惯了的

examples.en: She is not accustomed to driving for a long time.
examples.zh: 她不习惯长时间驾车。

examples.en: You will soon get accustomed to living in this country.
examples.zh: 你很快就会习惯这个国家的生活模式了。

examples.en: I'm accustomed to sleeping in a room without air conditioning.
examples.zh: 我习惯在没有空调的房间里睡觉。

ache.definition: n. a dull persistent (usually moderately intense) pain\nv. have a desire for something or someone who is not present\nv. be the source of pain
ache.translation: n. 疼痛\nvi. 痛, 哀怜, 渴望

examples.en: The pain is here, right? That's a stomach ache.
examples.zh: 这里疼是吗？那是胃痛。

examples.en: It's ached before, but never as badly as right now.
examples.zh: 痛过，但是没现在这么厉害。

examples.en: My joints ache when it gets cold.
examples.zh: 当天气变冷的时候，我的关节疼痛。

achieve.translation: vt. 完成, 达到\nvi. 如愿以偿

examples.en: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
examples.zh: 你们准备如何达到你们制定的目标？

examples.en: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
examples.zh: 如果你不更加努力地学习, 你将永远不会有所成就。

examples.en: In my view, studying hard is the best way to achieve success.
examples.zh: 对我来说，努力学习就是最好取得成功的办法。

achievement.definition: n the action of accomplishing something
achievement.translation: n. 完成, 成就, 功业

examples.en: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.
examples.zh: 登月是一项里程碑式的成就。

examples.en: No matter how many faults there are, our achievements are the main thing.
examples.zh: 不管缺点怎么多，成绩还是最主要的。

examples.en: His thesis summed up the new achievements made in computers, artificial satellites and rockets.
examples.zh: 他的论文总结了电脑，人造卫星和火箭三个的新成就。

acid.definition: n. any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt\nn. street name for lysergic acid diethylamide\ns. having the characteristics of an acid
acid.translation: n. 酸, 酸类物质, 尖刻, 迷幻药\na. 酸的, 酸性的, 尖刻的, 敏锐的\n[计] 自动文档互参与索引生成程序

examples.en: Tom fell into a vat of sulfuric acid.
examples.zh: Tom 摔倒进一桶硫酸中

examples.en: There is too much acid in this orange.
examples.zh: 这个柳橙太酸了。

examples.en: Yesterday I read an article about acid rain.
examples.zh: 昨天我读了关于酸雨的文章。

acknowledge.definition:
v. report the receipt of
v. express obligation, thanks, or gratitude for
v. accept as legally binding and valid
v. accept (someone) to be what is claimed or accept his power and authority
acknowledge.translation: vt. 承认, 告知收悉, 答谢, 报偿\n[经] 承认, 答谢, 收到的通知

examples.en: Acknowledge your own faults before criticizing others.
examples.zh: 要批评别人时，先想想自己是否完美无缺。

examples.en: Superstitions derive from the inability of men to acknowledge that coincidences are merely coincidences.
examples.zh: 迷信之所以存在，是因为人无法接受巧合只是巧合而已。

examples.en: You should acknowledge your failure.
examples.zh: 你应该承认自己的失败。

examples.en: Yes, people usually curse at someone they are acquainted with.
examples.zh: 对，人通常会对自己的熟人口出恶言。

examples.en: I am acquainted with one Mr. Smith.
examples.zh: 我认识一位史密斯先生。

examples.en: How did you get acquainted with her?
examples.zh: 你是怎样认识她的？

acquaintance.definition: n. personal knowledge or information about someone or something\nn. a relationship less intimate than friendship\nn. a person with whom you are acquainted

examples.en: She is more of an acquaintance than a friend.
examples.zh: 与其说她是我的朋友，不如说她只是一个我认识的人。

examples.en: Mr Smith is an acquaintance of hers.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生是她的一个相识。

examples.en: I am glad to make your acquaintance.
examples.zh: 我很高兴能够认识您。

acquire.definition: v. locate (a moving entity) by means of a tracking system such as radar\nv. win something through one's efforts
acquire.translation: vt. 获得, 学到\n[电] 目标锁定

examples.en: Had I the money, I would immediately acquire this computer.
examples.zh: 我要是有钱，立马就买这台电脑。

examples.en: You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
examples.zh: 你要学的是实实在在的技能，而不单是表面的知识。

examples.en: One can acquire this book in one store only.
examples.zh: 只有一家商店卖这本书。

acquisition.definition: n. the act of contracting or assuming or acquiring possession of something\nn. something acquired
acquisition.translation: n. 获得, 获得物\n[经] 收购, 招揽, 取得

examples.en: GE announced the acquisition of the company Laku for $30 million.
GE announced the acquisition of the Lake company for $30 million.
Happiness doesn't lie in insight, but in its acquisition.

acre.definition: n. a unit of area (4840 square yards) used in English-speaking countries\nn. a territory of western Brazil bordering on Bolivia and Peru\nn. a town and port in northwestern Israel in the eastern Mediterranean

examples.en: The pasture has an area of 10 acres.
examples.zh: 牧场的面积有10英亩。

examples.en: That pasture is ten acres.
examples.zh: 那个牧场有十英亩大。

across.definition: r. to the opposite side\nr. transversely
across.translation: prep. 越过, 穿过, 与...相交叉, 在...的对面\nadv. 交叉, 到另一边, 在对面, 成十字

examples.en: How long would it take to swim across the river?
examples.zh: 游过这条河要多久？

examples.en: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
examples.zh: 他偶然在古董店里发现了这个旧硬币。

examples.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
examples.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。

act.definition:
n. a legal document codifying the result of deliberations of a committee or society or legislative body
n. something that people do or cause to happen
n. a subdivision of a play or opera or ballet
n. a short theatrical performance that is part of a longer program
act.translation:
n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案
vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当
vt. 扮演, 装作
[计] 先进通信技术, 先进计算机工艺, 自动代码翻译技术

examples.en: You say one thing and then act just the opposite.
examples.zh: 你说一套做一套。

examples.en: To forgive others is an act of kindness to yourself.
examples.zh: 原谅别人就是善待自己。

examples.en: He must be a gentleman to act that way.
examples.zh: 这样的举止只可能是个绅士。

action.definition:
n. something done (usually as opposed to something said)
n. the state of being active
n. the series of events that form a plot
n. the trait of being active and energetic and forceful
action.translation: n. 行动, 活动, 动作, 作用, 战斗, 行为, 诉讼\nvt. 对...起诉\n[计] 方式

examples.en: Action speaks louder than words, but not nearly as often.
examples.zh: 行胜于言，但并不是所有情况都是这样。

examples.en: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
examples.zh: 律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。

examples.en: We took action immediately so that things wouldn't get worse.
examples.zh: 为了避免情况恶化，我们马上采取了行动。

activate.definition:
v. make active or more active
v. make more adsorptive
v. aerate (sewage) so as to favor the growth of organisms that decompose organic matter
v. make (substances) radioactive
activate.translation: vt. 使活动, 使激活, 正式建成\nvi. 有活力

examples.en: Their goal and activating main idea was indeed brotherhood and justice among the peoples.
examples.zh: 他们的目标和活动的主要思想是真正的四海一家和各民族的普遍公正。

active.definition:
n. a person who is a participating member of an organization
a. tending to become more severe or wider in scope
s. engaged in or ready for military or naval operations
a. disposed to take action or effectuate change
active.translation: a. 活跃的, 起作用的, 积极的, 有效的, 主动的, 活性的, 现行的, 现役的\nn. 主动语态, 积极分子

examples.en: Mary isn't as active as her sister.
examples.zh: 玛丽没她姐妹活跃。

examples.en: Mary is an active person, isn't she?
examples.zh: 玛丽她很活跃，不是吗？

examples.en: There are many active volcanoes in Japan.
examples.zh: 日本有很多活火山。

activity.definition: n. any specific behavior\nn. (chemistry) the capacity of a substance to take part in a chemical reaction
activity.translation: n. 活动, 行动, 活跃, 活力\n[计] 活动

examples.en: The activity of foreign trade has been declining of late.
examples.zh: 最近对外贸易活动减少了。

examples.en: Every month at our company, they run a community activity.
examples.zh: 在我们公司每月都会举办社团活动。

examples.en: The movie called "Paranormal Activity" was not that much good.
examples.zh: 那部叫“鬼影实录”的电影并没那么好。

actor.definition: n. a theatrical performer\nn. a person who acts and gets things done
actor.translation: n. 男演员, 行动者\n[医] 作用物, 反应物

examples.en: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
examples.zh: 你想成为一名电影演员吗？

examples.en: My dream is to make it as an actor in Hollywood.
examples.zh: 我的梦想是成为一个成功的荷里活演员。

examples.en: He is not a singer, but an actor.
examples.zh: 他不是歌手，但是个演员。

examples.en: Her mind is filled with dreams of becoming an actress.
examples.zh: 她心中充满了成为女演员的梦想。

examples.en: Emily is a well-known actress in her own country.
examples.zh: 艾蜜莉是本国的著名女演员。

examples.en: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
examples.zh: 她不但是一个演员，她还曾是一个著名的画家。

actual.definition:
a. presently existing in fact and not merely potential or possible
s. taking place in reality; not pretended or imitated
s. being or reflecting the essential or genuine character of something
s. existing in act or fact
actual.translation: a. 真实的, 实际的, 现行的\n[医] 实际死亡率

examples.en: To date nobody knows the actual size of the cosmos.
examples.zh: 宇宙的实际大小至今无人知道。

examples.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
examples.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

examples.en: This story is based on actual events.
examples.zh: 这个故事是基于真实事件写的。

actually.definition:
r. in actual fact
r. used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated; surprisingly
r. at the present moment
r. as a sentence modifier to add slight emphasis
actually.translation: adv. 事实上, 竟然, 如今, 现在

examples.en: You didn't actually want to go to Australia, did you?
examples.zh: 你其实不想去澳大利亚吧？

examples.en: Most people can't actually recognize the back of their hand.
examples.zh: 大多数人其实认不出自己的手背。

examples.en: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
examples.zh: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。

acute.definition:
a. having or experiencing a rapid onset and short but severe course
s. extremely sharp or intense
s. having or demonstrating ability to recognize or draw fine distinctions
a. of an angle; less than 90 degrees
acute.translation: a. 尖锐的, 敏锐的, 激烈的, 严重的, 急性的\n[医] 急性的; 尖锐的

examples.en: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
examples.zh: 她因为敏锐的观察力，很适合当一名摄影师。

examples.en: He's suffering from acute pain in his life.
examples.zh: 他一生为急性疼痛所苦。

examples.en: A blind person's hearing is often very acute.
examples.zh: 盲人的耳朵通常十分灵敏。

ad.definition: n. a public promotion of some product or service\nr. in the Christian era; used before dates after the supposed year Christ was born
ad.translation: n. 广告\n[计] 地址, 模拟-数字

examples.en: The classified ad wanted female singers to form an a cappella group.
examples.zh: 这则分类广告招募女歌手组成无伴奏合唱团。

examples.en: There are too many ads on YouTube.
examples.zh: YouTube 上的广告太多了。

adapt.definition: v. make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose
adapt.translation: vt. 使适应, 改编\nvi. 适应

examples.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
examples.zh: 人类适应环境变化的能力很强。

examples.en: Some plants cannot adapt themselves to the cold.
examples.zh: 有些植物无法适应寒冷。

examples.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.
examples.zh: 我适应新环境很慢。

adaptation.definition: n. a written work (as a novel) that has been recast in a new form\nn. the process of adapting to something (such as environmental conditions)\nn. (physiology) the responsive adjustment of a sense organ (as the eye) to varying conditions (as of light)
adaptation.translation: n. 适应, 改编, 改编本\n[医] 适应[作用]

examples.en: The adaptation was so sugar-coated it made me sick.
This film is an adaptation of a novel.
There's an American adaptation of that French movie.

add.definition:
v. make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of
v. state or say further
v. make an addition by combining numbers
v. constitute an addition
add.translation: vt. 增加, 添加, 附带说明, 计算...总和\nvi. 做加法, 积累而成, 增添\n[计] 加法

examples.en: I wanted to add Mary as a friend on Facebook.
examples.zh: 我想加玛莉的脸书好友。

examples.en: In winter, I always need to add an extra quilt.
examples.zh: 冬天我总是需要多加条被子。

examples.en: Would you like to add anything to what I've said?
examples.zh: 您对我说的话有什么要补充的吗？

addition.definition:
n. a component that is added to something to improve it
n. the act of adding one thing to another
n. a quantity that is added
n. a suburban area laid out in streets and lots for a future residential area
addition.translation: n. 加法, 增加的人(或物)\n[计] 加法

examples.en: It was cold, and in addition, it was windy.
examples.zh: 天气很冷，而且风很大。

examples.en: We had to pay ten thousand yen in addition.
examples.zh: 我们还得付多一万日元。

examples.en: We are expecting an addition to our family.
examples.zh: 我们家快要添丁了。

additional.translation: a. 附加的, 另外的, 额外的\n[机] 加添的, 附加的

examples.en: We decided to stay an additional day.
examples.zh: 我们决定多待一天。

examples.en: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
examples.zh: 因此，必须进行额外的测试以确保完整的安全性。

examples.en: Customers who purchase a new device can enjoy additional trial period as a promotional offer.
examples.zh: 购买新装置的用户可享有额外试用优惠。

address.definition:
n. (computer science) the code that identifies where a piece of information is stored
n. the place where a person or organization can be found or communicated with
n. the act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience
n. the manner of speaking to another individual
address.translation: n. 住址, 演说, 举止, 灵巧, 求爱\nvt. 发表(演说或讲话), 对付, 写地址\n[计] 地址, 寻址

examples.en: If I knew his address, I could write to him.
examples.zh: 如果我知道他的地址，就能写信给他了。

examples.en: I can't for the life of me remember her address.
examples.zh: 她的住址无论如何也想不起来。

examples.en: Please fill in your name and address on this form.
examples.zh: 请在这张表格上填上你的姓名和住址。

adequate.definition: a. having the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task\ns. sufficient for the purpose\ns. about average; acceptable
adequate.translation: a. 适当的, 足够的\n[法] 胜任的, 适当的, 充分的

examples.en: We need not only adequate water but clean water.
examples.zh: 我们不仅需要充足的水，还需要干净的水。

examples.en: This meal is adequate for three.
examples.zh: 这饭足够三个人吃。

examples.en: With adequate lighting, one can easily discern Nosferatu, with his pointed incisors and extremely long-limbed fingers, known as arachnodactyly, from common vampires.
examples.zh: 在光线充足的情况下，诺斯费拉图与普通吸血鬼很容易区分。诺斯费拉图有著尖锐的门牙，以及极为修长的手指，即所谓的蜘蛛指。

adhere.definition:
v. be compatible or in accordance with
v. follow through or carry out a plan without deviation
v. be a devoted follower or supporter
v. stick to firmly
adhere.translation: vi. 依附, 粘着, 坚持, 追随, 拥护\nvt. 使粘附

examples.en: He adhered to the original plan.
examples.zh: 他坚持原来的计划。

adjacent.definition: s. nearest in space or position; immediately adjoining without intervening space\ns. having a common boundary or edge; abutting; touching; Massachusetts and Conncecticut"\ns. near or close to but not necessarily touching
adjacent.translation: a. 毗连的, 邻近的, 连接的\n[机] 相邻的, 邻位的, 交界的

examples.en: The living room is adjacent to the dining room.
examples.zh: 客厅紧邻著餐厅。

examples.en: The post office is adjacent to the library.
examples.zh: 邮局在图书馆旁边。

examples.en: The stadium is adjacent to the school.
examples.zh: 体育场毗邻学校。

adjective.definition: n. a word that expresses an attribute of something\nn. the word class that qualifies nouns\na. relating to court practice and procedure as opposed to the principles of law
adjective.translation: n. 形容词\na. 形容词的, 从属的

examples.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，形容词放在名词前面。

examples.en: Things that modify nouns (adjective, or adjectival equivalent).
examples.zh: 修饰名词的东西（形容词，或形容词相等语）。

examples.en: You have to put an adjective after "不够."
examples.zh: 不够后面要再加个形容词

adjust.definition:
v. alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard
v. adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
v. make correspondent or conformable
v. decide how much is to be paid on an insurance claim
adjust.translation: vt. 调整, 使适应于, 校准\nvi. 适应于, 被调节, 相互熟悉而适应

examples.en: I need a week to adjust to the time difference.
examples.zh: 我需要一个星期来倒时差。

examples.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the dark.
examples.zh: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。

examples.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
examples.zh: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。

adjustment.definition: n. making or becoming suitable; adjusting to circumstances\nn. the act of adjusting something to match a standard
adjustment.translation: n. 调整, 调节, 校正\n[化] 调节

examples.en: She made a quick adjustment to her new job.
The decline is not as sharp after seasonal adjustment.
The adjustment of the machinery was taken care of by engineers.

administer.definition:
v. work in an administrative capacity; supervise or be in charge of
v. perform (a church sacrament) ritually
v. give or apply (medications)
v. direct the taking of
administer.translation: vt. 管理, 料理, 执行\nvi. 执行遗产管理人的职责, 给予帮助

examples.en: The doctor administered medicine to the patient.
examples.zh: 医生向病人用药。

examples.en: The medication should be administered topically.
examples.zh: 此药只供外用。

administration.definition:
n. a method of tending to or managing the affairs of a some group of people (especially the group's business affairs)
n. the persons (or committees or departments etc.) who make up a body for the purpose of administering something
n. the act of administering medication
n. the act of meting out justice according to the law
administration.translation: n. 行政, 管理, 政府机关\n[化] 给药

examples.en: She just went to the administration to get a check.
They sent us to the administration office of the factory.
During his administration a great many new laws were passed.

admire.definition: v. feel admiration for\nv. look at with admiration
admire.translation: vt. 赞美, 钦佩, 爱慕\nvi. 称赞, 惊奇

examples.en: She stopped before the mirror to admire herself.
examples.zh: 她在镜前停下脚步，自我欣赏了一番。

examples.en: Tom and Mary admired the scenery as they held hands.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽手牵着手，一起欣赏风景。

examples.en: The sea is admired by those who don't go to sea.
examples.zh: 不出海的人，也对大海心生敬仰。

admission.definition: n. the act of admitting someone to enter\nn. an acknowledgment of the truth of something
admission.translation: n. 准许进入, 入场费, 录用, 承认\n[经] 加入, 入股

examples.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
examples.zh: 五岁以下的小孩票价全免。

examples.en: He made an admission that he had lied.
examples.zh: 他承认他撒谎了。

examples.en: The admission is ten dollars a person.
examples.zh: 入场费一个人10美元。

admit.definition:
v. declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
v. allow to enter; grant entry to
v. allow participation in or the right to be part of; permit to exercise the rights, functions, and responsibilities of
v. afford possibility
admit.translation: vt. 承认, 接受, 允许进入, 容许\nvi. 开向, 容许, 承认

examples.en: I admit, at that time I was a little drunk.
examples.zh: 我承认当时是有点醉。

examples.en: I admit I'm not the tidiest person in the world.
examples.zh: 我承认，我不是世界上最整洁的人。

examples.en: I admit, I'm not the tidiest person in the world.
examples.zh: 我承认，我不是世界上最整洁的人。

adolescent.definition:
n. a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
a. relating to or peculiar to or suggestive of an adolescent
s. being of the age 13 through 19
s. displaying or suggesting a lack of maturity
adolescent.translation: a. 青春期的, 青少年的\nn. 青少年

examples.en: It is said that adolescent friendships do not often last.
The book is considered a classic piece of adolescent literature.
There's nothing more forced than an adolescent trying to look natural.

adopt.definition: v. choose and follow; as of theories, ideas, policies, strategies or plans\nv. take up and practice as one's own\nv. take into one's family
adopt.translation: vt. 采用, 正式通过, 收养, 接受\n[医] 采取

examples.en: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.
examples.zh: 我认为采用他的计划对我们比较好。

examples.en: The government will adopt enforcement measures to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 政府将采取强制措施来解决这一问题。

examples.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
examples.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

adult.definition: n. a fully developed person from maturity onward\nn. any mature animal\ns. (of animals) fully developed
adult.translation: n. 成人, 成虫\na. 成年的, 成熟的

examples.en: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
examples.zh: 请给我两张到伦敦的成人票，三张儿童票。

examples.en: Sixty-nine percent of adult Americans are either overweight or obese.
examples.zh: 69%的美国成人超重或肥胖。

examples.en: This person is new to being an adult.
examples.zh: 此人涉世不深。

advance.definition:
n. an amount paid before it is earned
n. increase in price or value
v. move forward, also in the metaphorical sense
v. bring forward for consideration or acceptance
advance.translation:
n. 前进, 进展, 行过的路程
vi. 前进, 进展, 提高, 上涨
vt. 使前进, 促进, 提出, 提高, 使提前, 预付
a. 前面的, 预先的

examples.en: The world today needs to advance its production of food.
examples.zh: 当今世界需推进其食物生产。

examples.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.
examples.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。

examples.en: When I call on you, I'll let you know in advance.
examples.zh: 我若拜访你，会让你提前知道的。

advanced.definition:
s. farther along in physical or mental development
s. comparatively late in a course of development
s. ahead of the times
s. at a higher level in training or knowledge or skill
advanced.translation: a. 在前的, 高级的, 先进的, 年老的\n[法] 预付的, 预支的, 垫付的

examples.en: The military power of this country is very advanced.
examples.zh: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。

examples.en: The squirrel advanced against the strong wind.
examples.zh: 松鼠在前面顶著强风。

examples.en: They advanced to the quarter-finals.
examples.zh: 他们挺进了八强。

advantage.definition:
n. the quality of having a superior or more favorable position
n. (tennis) first point scored after deuce
n. benefit resulting from some event or action
v. give an advantage to
advantage.translation: n. 优点, 便利, 好处, 优势\nvt. 有助于

examples.en: If you can use gravity to your advantage, do so.
examples.zh: 你如果能利用重力，那就这么做吧。

examples.en: Having a driver's license is an advantage for this job.
examples.zh: 有驾照者优先得到这个职位。

examples.en: The home team always have an advantage over their opponents.
examples.zh: 主场队总是比对手有优势。

adventure.definition: n. a wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)
adventure.translation: n. 冒险, 冒险经历\nv. 冒险

examples.en: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
examples.zh: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。

examples.en: He has an innate love of adventure.
examples.zh: 他天生热爱冒险。

examples.en: Gulliver traveled in quest of adventure.
examples.zh: 格列佛为寻求探险而旅行。

adverb.definition: n. the word class that qualifies verbs or clauses\nn. a word that modifies something other than a noun

examples.en: This is an adverb.
examples.zh: 这是个副词。

adverse.definition: s. contrary to your interests or welfare\ns. in an opposing direction
adverse.translation: a. 不利的, 敌对的, 相反的, 逆的\n[法] 相反的, 敌对的, 逆的

examples.en: Our plane was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
The rehearsal was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
There's no way to alleviate the adverse effects of the medication.

advertise.definition: v. call attention to\nv. make publicity for; try to sell (a product)
advertise.translation: vt. 做广告, 通知, 公布\nvi. 做广告

examples.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
examples.zh: 那家公司在广告上花了很多钱。

examples.en: We advertise our products on TV.
examples.zh: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。

examples.en: Many websites are supported by revenue from advertising.
examples.zh: 许多网站都是靠广告收入来维持的。

advertisement.definition: n a public promotion of some product or service
advertisement.translation: n. 广告, 启事, 广告宣传\n[法] 广告, 公告, 告示

examples.en: Thousands of people are very disappointed with this advertisement.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人对这个广告很失望。

examples.en: Thousands of people were very disappointed with this advertisement.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人对这个广告很失望。

examples.en: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
examples.zh: 我们已经收到了很多回应我们广告的申请。

advice.definition: n. a proposal for an appropriate course of action
advice.translation: n. 忠告, 劝告, 意见, 报道, 通知\n[经] 通知书, 通知, 建议

examples.en: I need your advice on what I should do next.
examples.zh: 我需要你指导我接下来该做甚么。

examples.en: Please give me some advice on what I should do.
examples.zh: 请给我提提建议，我该做什么。

examples.en: It is necessary for you to follow your mother's advice.
examples.zh: 你必须听你母亲的建议。

advise.translation: vt. 劝告, 给...出主意, 通知, 建议\nvi. 提意见, 商量

examples.en: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
examples.zh: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

examples.en: She was advised by him to go to the police.
examples.zh: 他劝她去报警。

examples.en: The doctor advised my father to cut down on smoking.
examples.zh: 医生建议我父亲少吸烟。

advocate.definition: n. a person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea\nn. a lawyer who pleads cases in court
advocate.translation: n. 提倡者, 拥护者\nvt. 主张, 提倡

examples.en: China is an advocate for the Diaoyu Islands' sovereignty.
examples.zh: 中国主张钓鱼岛的主权。

examples.en: More and more environmentalists advocate and use environmentally friendly unleaded petrol in cars.
examples.zh: 越来越多的环保者开始宣传和使用以环保的无铅汽油为燃料的汽车。

examples.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.
examples.zh: 我在给魔鬼当辩护士。

aerial.definition: a. existing or living or growing or operating in the air
aerial.translation: a. 空中的, 航空的, 空气的, 空想的\nn. 天线

examples.en: The children played hide-and-seek among the banyan tree's aerial roots.
We flew above the area for an aerial survey.
Ziri put the ivy's aerial roots in water and they grew.

affair.definition: n. a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship\nn. a vaguely specified social event
affair.translation: n. 事件, 事务, 恋爱事件

examples.en: Sami was having an affair with a girl named Layla.
examples.zh: 萨米和一个叫莱拉的女生有染。

examples.en: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.
examples.zh: 我们的爱情就像肥皂泡一样脆弱。

examples.en: I don't want to be involved in this affair.
examples.zh: 我可不想卷入这场纷争中去。

affect.definition:
n. the conscious subjective aspect of feeling or emotion
v. have an effect upon
v. act physically on; have an effect upon
v. have an emotional or cognitive impact upon
affect.translation: vt. 影响, 感动, 假装, 模仿, 爱好, 倾向于\nn. 自觉感情

examples.en: An increase in the number of cars will affect the urban environment.
examples.zh: 车辆增多会影响到城市的环境。

examples.en: Generally speaking, nobles were only very slightly affected by taxes.
examples.zh: 总体来说，贵族受到税收的影响微乎其微。

examples.en: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
examples.zh: 其他人的期望会影响我们的行为。

affection.definition: n. a positive feeling of liking
affection.translation: n. 影响, 病, 喜爱, 情感, 倾向\n[医] 疾患, 病变, 病; 感情

examples.en: Everyone knows of his affection for that dog.
examples.zh: 人人都知道他对那狗的感情。

examples.en: Every mother has affection for her child.
examples.zh: 每个母亲都疼爱自己的孩子。

examples.en: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
examples.zh: 虽然激情可能会褪去，却不容它破坏我们感情上的联系。

affirm.definition: v. to declare or affirm solemnly and formally as true\nv. say yes to

examples.en: It doesn't matter how others see you. What is important is to be sure to affirm your own self.
examples.zh: 别人怎样看自己不重要,重要的是要保证自己得到自己的认同。

afford.definition: v. be able to spare or give up\nv. have the financial means to do something or buy something\nv. afford access to
afford.translation: vt. 买得起, 足以, 给予

examples.en: This car was so cheap that he could afford it.
examples.zh: 这车便宜得让他能买得起。

examples.en: I can't afford to eat in such an expensive restaurant.
examples.zh: 我吃不起这么贵的餐馆。

examples.en: I can't afford to buy such an expensive car.
examples.zh: 我买不起这么贵的轿车。

afraid.definition:
a. filled with fear or apprehension
s. filled with regret or concern; used often to soften an unpleasant statement
s. feeling worry or concern or insecurity
s. having feelings of aversion or unwillingness
afraid.translation: a. 害怕的, 恐怕的, 遗憾的

examples.en: I am not in the least afraid of his threats.
examples.zh: 我一点也不怕他威胁。

examples.en: He said that he was afraid it would be rainy.
examples.zh: 他说他怕天会下雨。

examples.en: The girl was afraid to jump down from the roof.
examples.zh: 小女孩害怕从屋顶上跳下来。

after.definition: s. located farther aft\nr. behind or in the rear
after.translation: prep. 在...之后, 由于\nconj. 在...之后\nadv. 后来

examples.en: Give me back the book after you have read it.
examples.zh: 在你读完后，把书还给我。

examples.en: After she had lunch, she got ready to go out.
examples.zh: 吃过午饭后，她准备好要出门了。

examples.en: Her feet were tired after a long day at work.
examples.zh: 在一整天工作的奔波中，她的腿变得酸痛。

afternoon.definition: n. the part of the day between noon and evening

examples.en: I am taking my son to the zoo this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午带我儿子去动物园。

examples.en: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?
examples.zh: 你今天下午想不想去动物园？

examples.en: Tom is going to be coming here later this afternoon.
examples.zh: 汤姆今天下午会来这里。

afterward.definition: r happening at a time subsequent to a reference time

examples.en: If you use the toilet, flush it afterward.
examples.zh: 使用厕所后请冲水。

examples.en: I studied for more than two hours, and afterward I went to bed.
examples.zh: 我学习了两个多小时，然后就去睡觉了。

examples.en: A cloud of dust and debris rose and lingered in the sky for a few minutes afterward.
examples.zh: 一团尘土与瓦砾腾空而起，在空中盘旋了数分钟。

again.translation: adv. 再一次, 又, 到原处

examples.en: It is foolish of him to pay for it again.
examples.zh: 这是他的愚蠢付出代价了。

examples.en: I will make it clear that I won't come again.
examples.zh: 我要明确表示我不会再来了。

examples.en: It was not long before we met again by chance.
examples.zh: 没多久，我们又碰巧遇到了。

against.definition:
prep. Abreast; opposite to; facing; towards; as, against the
   mouth of a river; -- in this sense often preceded by over.
prep. From an opposite direction so as to strike or come in
   contact with; in contact with; upon; as, hail beats against the roof.
prep. In opposition to, whether the opposition is of
   sentiment or of action; on the other side; counter to; in contrariety
   to; hence, adverse to; as, against reason; against law; to run a race
   against time.
prep. By of before the time that; in preparation for; so as
   to be ready for the time when.
against.translation: prep. 反对, 对着, 倚靠

examples.en: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.
examples.zh: 你可能是对的，但我和你意见相反。

examples.en: Anything you say can be used against you in court.
examples.zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

examples.en: Tom didn't know what he'd done was against the rules.
examples.zh: 汤姆不知道他的所作所为违反了规则。

age.definition:
n. how long something has existed
n. a time of life (usually defined in years) at which some particular qualification or power arises
v. begin to seem older; get older
v. make older
age.translation: n. 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期\nv. 变老, 成熟

examples.en: You work as hard as he did at your age.
examples.zh: 你跟他在你这个年纪时一样努力工作。

examples.en: The Golden Age of the Romans is in the past.
examples.zh: 罗马人的黄金时代已过去了。

examples.en: Can a child of her age distinguish good from bad?
examples.zh: 一个像她那么大的小孩能够分辨是非吗？

agency.definition: n. an administrative unit of government\nn. a business that serves other businesses\nn. the state of being in action or exerting power
agency.translation: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介\n[化] 办事处

examples.en: The car rental agency provided excellent customer service.
examples.zh: 这家汽车租赁公司提供了优质的客服业务。

examples.en: I work in a travel agency.
examples.zh: 我在旅行社工作.

examples.en: I work at a travel agency.
examples.zh: 我在旅行社工作.

agenda.definition: n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to\nn. a list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting)
agenda.translation: pl. 议程, 日常工作事项\n[计] 待议事件

examples.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
examples.zh: 让我们继续进行议程上的项目。

agent.definition:
n. an active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect
n. a representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations
n. a substance that exerts some force or effect
n. a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission
agent.translation: n. 代理商, 政府代表, 动原, 媒介\n[计] 代理程序

examples.en: I'm not signing anything until I speak with my agent.
examples.zh: 在跟我的经纪人谈过之前，我不会签任何东西。

examples.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
examples.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

examples.en: A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
examples.zh: 旅行社会为你安排去安达卢西亚的旅行。

aggravate.definition: v make worse\nv exasperate or irritate
aggravate.translation: vt. 使恶化, 使更严重, 加重

examples.en: Ziri seemed to get more aggravated the longer Rima talked.
The taunts at the end of the match failed to aggravate Tom.
Sami was found guilty of aggravated assault and attempted murder.

aggregate.definition:
n. material such as sand or gravel used with cement and water to make concrete, mortar, or plaster
n. a sum total of many heterogenous things taken together
v. amount in the aggregate to
v. gather in a mass, sum, or whole
aggregate.translation:
n. 合计, 总计, 聚集体
a. 合计的, 聚集的
v. 聚集, 集合, 合计达
[计] 聚合体; 聚集

examples.en: Heliotrope is a mineral aggregate commonly also known as bloodstone.
Strawberries and raspberries are both examples of an aggregate fruit.
Simply put, a human being is an aggregate of many cells.

aggressive.definition: a. having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends; positive in his convictions"\ns. tending to spread quickly\ns. characteristic of an enemy or one eager to fight
aggressive.translation: a. 侵略的, 挑畔的, 进取的\n[法] 侵略的, 爱挑衅的, 行为过火的

examples.en: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.
examples.zh: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。

examples.en: Mary is very aggressive, isn't she?
examples.zh: 玛丽有些咄咄逼人，不是吗？

examples.en: Sami became more aggressive with customers.
examples.zh: 萨米对顾客变得更加挑衅了。

agitate.definition: v. try to stir up public opinion\nv. cause to be agitated, excited, or roused\nv. change the arrangement or position of
agitate.translation: vt. 使摇动, 搅动, 使激动, 使不安\nvi. 鼓动, 煽动

examples.en: Agitated activity by certain animals may be a sign of an impending earthquake.
examples.zh: 某些动物烦躁不安, 可能是地震临震前的预兆。

examples.en: Tom looked like he was agitated.
examples.zh: 汤姆看起来很激动。

examples.en: Don't get agitated. It's nothing.
examples.zh: 别慌。这没什么的。

ago.definition: s. gone by; or in the past\nr. in the past

examples.en: I saw him at the station a few days ago.
examples.zh: 几天前我在站看到了他。

examples.en: Was there a book on the desk a moment ago?
examples.zh: 刚才桌子上有一本书吗？

examples.en: The city isn't the one I left six years ago.
examples.zh: 城市已经不是我六年前离开时的城市。

agony.definition: n. intense feelings of suffering; acute mental or physical pain\nn. a state of acute pain
agony.translation: n. 极大的痛苦, 挣扎\n[医] 濒死苦闷; 剧痛

examples.en: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story.
Ziri heard the sound of an animal in agony.
At the time of her death, she suffers agony.

agree.definition:
v. be in accord; be in agreement
v. consent or assent to a condition, or agree to do something
v. show grammatical agreement
v. be agreeable or suitable
agree.translation: vi. 同意, 赞成, 应允, 适合\nvt. 承认, 认定, 同意

examples.en: It is strange for Ken not to agree with us.
examples.zh: 肯不同意我们，是件奇怪的事。

examples.en: Do you agree with what he says in the book?
examples.zh: 你赞成他在书中说的话吗？

examples.en: Whether you agree or not, I'm going to do it.
examples.zh: 不管你同意还是不同意，我还是要做。

agreement.definition:
n. the statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises
n. compatibility of observations
n. harmony of people's opinions or actions or characters
n. the thing arranged or agreed to
agreement.translation: n. 同意, 合约, 协议\n[经] 契约, 协议, 协定

examples.en: We made an agreement to meet exactly at ten.
examples.zh: 我们彼此同意在十点整见面。

examples.en: I'm not in agreement with your methods at all.
examples.zh: 我完全不认可你的方法。

examples.en: There needs to be agreement between European countries.
examples.zh: 欧洲各国之间需要达成协议。

agriculture.definition: n. the class of people engaged in growing food
agriculture.translation: n. 农业\n[机] 农业, 农学

examples.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
examples.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。

examples.en: This land is not suitable for agriculture.
examples.zh: 这片地不适合发展农业。

examples.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.
examples.zh: 农业需要消耗大量的水。

ahead.definition:
s. having the leading position or higher score in a contest
r. at or in the front
r. toward the future; forward in time
r. in a forward direction
ahead.translation: a. 领先的, 预先的, 向前的\nadv. 领先, 预先, 向前, 胜于, 在前面, 在将来

examples.en: Skip the problems you can not do and go ahead.
examples.zh: 跳过做不出来的题目，继续往后做。

examples.en: Hurry up. We're about to pass that car up ahead.
examples.zh: 快点儿，马上就要超过前面那辆车了。

examples.en: You can't get ahead if you don't work hard.
examples.zh: 一分耕耘，一分收获。

aid.definition: n. a resource\nn. the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose\nn. money to support a worthy person or cause
aid.translation:
n. 帮助, 外援, 助手
vt. 援助, 帮助, 有助于
vi. 帮助
[计] 自动内部诊断

examples.en: Scientists are working hard to put an end to AIDS.
examples.zh: 科学家们正努力终结艾滋病。

examples.en: Doctor, please give this child first aid.
examples.zh: 医生，请给这孩子急救。

examples.en: Perhaps you will seek his aid.
examples.zh: 你也许要寻求他的帮助。

aim.definition:
n. the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)
n. the action of directing something at an object
v. point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards
v. propose or intend
aim.translation:
n. 目标, 瞄准, 击中目标的能力
vi. 对准目标, 致力, 打算
vt. 瞄准
[计] 医学文摘索引, 存取隔离机构, 高级信息管理程序, 先进接口模块
应用接口模块, 医学人工智能, 相联索引法, 异步接口模块
自动化信息管理, 自动化综合制造, 自动化库存管理

examples.en: I aim to be a doctor when I grow up.
examples.zh: 我长大了想当医生。

examples.en: He has only one aim in life, to make money.
examples.zh: 他的人生只有一个目标：赚钱。

examples.en: A stable economy is the aim of every government.
examples.zh: 经济繁荣稳定，是每个政府都想达到的目标。

air.definition:
n. a mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of
n. the region above the ground
n. a distinctive but intangible quality surrounding a person or thing
n. once thought to be one of four elements composing the universe (Empedocles)
air.translation: n. 空气, 旋律, 态度\nvt. 晾, 使通风, 夸耀

examples.en: How much will it cost you to go by air?
examples.zh: 坐飞机将花你多少钱？

examples.en: I don't like to leave things up in the air.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢让事情悬而未决。

examples.en: He dived into the water and came up for air.
examples.zh: 他潜进水里，然后又浮上水来换气。

aircraft.definition: n. a vehicle that can fly
aircraft.translation: n. 航空器, 飞机\n[机] 航空器

examples.en: China has the means to destroy your aircraft carriers.
examples.zh: 中国有能力摧毁你们的航空母舰。

airline.definition: n. a hose that carries air under pressure\nn. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers
airline.translation: n. 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司

examples.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
examples.zh: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？

examples.en: How is this airline?
examples.zh: 这个航空公司的飞机怎么样？

airplane.definition: n. an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets

examples.en: She won't take an airplane for fear of a crash.
examples.zh: 她不会乘飞机因为害怕坠机。

examples.en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
examples.zh: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。

examples.en: According to newspaper reports, there was an airplane accident last evening.
examples.zh: 根据报载，有一架飞机昨天晚上发生了意外。

airport.definition: n. an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo
airport.translation: n. 飞机场\n[机] 航空站, 机场

examples.en: I'll call as soon as I am at the airport.
examples.zh: 我一到机场就会打电话。

examples.en: I have been to the airport to see him off.
examples.zh: 我去飞机场为他送行了。

examples.en: I want to stay in a hotel near the airport.
examples.zh: 我想住在机场附近的旅馆里。

alarm.definition:
n. fear resulting from the awareness of danger
n. a device that signals the occurrence of some undesirable event
n. an automatic signal (usually a sound) warning of danger
v. warn or arouse to a sense of danger or call to a state of preparedness
alarm.translation: n. 惊恐, 警报, 警钟\nvt. 使惊恐, 警告\n[计] 报警信号

examples.en: Kurt didn't wake up yesterday because the alarm didn't ring.
examples.zh: 昨天闹钟没响，Kurt也就没醒过来。

examples.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
examples.zh: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。

examples.en: The alarm clock is set for 5 a.m.
examples.zh: 闹钟定在了早上5点。

album.definition: n. one or more recordings issued together; originally released on 12-inch phonograph records (usually with attractive record covers) and later on cassette audiotape and compact disc\nn. a book of blank pages with pockets or envelopes; for organizing photographs or stamp collections etc
album.translation: n. 粘贴簿, 唱片套\n[医] 白色物

examples.en: He sat quietly at his desk, flipping through the yellowed photo album.
examples.zh: 他静静地坐在书桌前，翻阅著那本泛黄的相簿。

examples.en: There is an album on the shelf.
examples.zh: 架上放著一本相簿。

examples.en: Will you show me your photo album?
examples.zh: 你能让我看看你的相簿吗？

alcohol.definition: n. a liquor or brew containing alcohol as the active agent\nn. any of a series of volatile hydroxyl compounds that are made from hydrocarbons by distillation
alcohol.translation: n. 酒精, 酒\n[化] 醇; 乙醇; 酒精

examples.en: What pain are you trying to cover up with alcohol?
examples.zh: 你借酒浇愁是为了什么事？

examples.en: Europeans are the largest consumers of alcohol in the world.
examples.zh: 欧洲人是世界上最大的酒精消费者。

examples.en: Europeans drink, on average, 12.5 liters of pure alcohol per year.
examples.zh: 欧洲人每年平均饮用十二点五公升的纯酒精。

alert.definition:
n. condition of heightened watchfulness or preparation for action
n. a warning serves to make you more alert to danger
a. engaged in or accustomed to close observation
s. quick and energetic
alert.translation: a. 警觉的, 灵敏的, 留心的\nn. 警报\nvt. 使警觉, 通知, 使意识到

examples.en: A tsunami is coming, so please be on the alert.
examples.zh: 海啸来了，密切注意啊。

examples.en: Alert, in Nunavut, Canada, is the northernmost permanently inhabited place in the world.
examples.zh: 加拿大努纳武特地区的阿勒特是世界上最北端的永久居住地。

examples.en: The tsunami alert was cancelled.
examples.zh: 海啸的警报解除了。

alien.definition: v. transfer property or ownership\ns. not contained in or deriving from the essential nature of something\ns. being or from or characteristic of another place or part of the world
alien.translation: n. 外国人, 外侨\na. 外国的, 相异的

examples.en: I swear, I saw an alien!
examples.zh: 我发誓我看到了外星人。

examples.en: Mary senses the aliens are watching her.
examples.zh: 玛丽发现外星人正在看她。

examples.en: Do you think there are aliens?
examples.zh: 你觉着有外星人存在吗？

alike.definition: a. having the same or similar characteristics\nr. equally\nr. in a like manner
alike.translation: a. 相似的, 同样的\nadv. 一样, 以同样的方式

examples.en: I hate women who say that all men are alike.
examples.zh: 我讨厌那些说男人都是一个样的女人。

examples.en: I hate women who say all men are alike.
examples.zh: 我讨厌那些说男人都是一个样的女人。

examples.en: Bill and his younger brother are nothing alike.
examples.zh: Bill和他的弟弟完全不同。

alive.definition:
a. possessing life
s. (often followed by `with') full of life and spirit
s. (followed by `to' or `of') aware of
s. capable of erupting
alive.translation: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的

examples.en: There is little, if any, hope of his being alive.
examples.zh: 我们几乎不抱他还活着的希望。

examples.en: Everybody knows for a fact that he is still alive.
examples.zh: 谁都知道他现在还在人世。

examples.en: I cannot help thinking that my son is still alive.
examples.zh: 我不禁想我的儿子一直都在生。

all.definition: a. quantifier; used with either mass or count nouns to indicate the whole number or amount of or every one of a class\ns. completely given to or absorbed by
all.translation:
a. 所有的, 全部的, 一切的
adv. 全部, 全然
pron. 全部
n. 全部

examples.en: We have a cat. We are all fond of it.
examples.zh: 我们有一只猫。我们都喜欢猫。

examples.en: He gave me all the money he had on him.
examples.zh: 他把他身上所有的钱都给了我。

examples.en: All I really want to do is talk to Tom.
examples.zh: 我就想跟汤姆说话。

allegation.definition: n. (law) a formal accusation against somebody (often in a court of law)\nn. statements affirming or denying certain matters of fact that you are prepared to prove
allegation.translation: n. 断言, 主张, 申辩\n[法] 声明, 事实陈述, 断言

examples.en: Tom was fired over a sexual harassment allegation.
The government's anti-corruption tsar resigned yesterday following allegations of bribery.
Tom had no idea if Mary's allegations were true.

allege.translation: vt. 宣称, 主张, 提出, 断言\n[法] 断言, 指称, 指证

examples.en: I allege that you are wrong, so I don't want to say a word anymore.
What did Tom allege?
They're alleging I bribed someone.

allergic.definition: a. characterized by or caused by allergy\ns. having an allergy or peculiar or excessive susceptibility (especially to a specific factor)
allergic.translation: a. 对...过敏的, 极反感的\n[医] 变应性的

examples.en: I know that Tom is allergic to bees.
examples.zh: 我知道汤姆对蜜蜂过敏。

examples.en: Probably you are allergic to pollen or dust.
examples.zh: 你可能对花粉或灰尘过敏。

examples.en: Don't forget that Tom is allergic to peanuts.
examples.zh: 不要忘记汤姆对花生过敏。

alley.definition: n. a narrow street with walls on both sides

examples.en: Turn north, walk to the second alley, and you're there.
examples.zh: 往北拐弯走到第二条弄堂就是。

examples.en: There is an alley behind my house.
examples.zh: 我家后面有条弄堂。

examples.en: There's an alley behind my house.
examples.zh: 我家后面有条胡同。

alliance.definition:
n. the state of being allied or confederated
n. a connection based on kinship or marriage or common interest
n. an organization of people (or countries) involved in a pact or treaty
n. a formal agreement establishing an association or alliance between nations or other groups to achieve a particular aim
alliance.translation: n. 联盟, 联合\n[法] 同盟, 联盟, 联姻

examples.en: There's new energy to harness, new jobs to be created, new schools to build, and threats to meet, alliances to repair.
examples.zh: 我们需要开发新的能源、创造新的工作岗位，我们需要修建新学校，应对众多威胁、修复与许多国家的盟友关系。

allocate.definition: v. distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose
allocate.translation: vt. 分派, 分配\n[计] 分配

examples.en: A committee of experts determines how to allocate the money.
They refuse to allocate enough funds to buy new ventilators.
Algeria needs to allocate resources to industry and agriculture.

allow.definition:
v. let have
v. give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause
v. allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something
v. grant as a discount or in exchange
allow.translation: vt. 允许, 同意给予, 承认\nvi. 容许, 猜想\n[计] 允许命令

examples.en: My father does not allow me to have a dog.
examples.zh: 我父亲不允许我养狗。

examples.en: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.
examples.zh: 希望你父母会让我们结婚吧。

examples.en: I hope your parents will allow us to get married.
examples.zh: 希望你父母会让我们结婚吧。

allowance.definition:
n. an amount allowed or granted (as during a given period)
n. a sum granted as reimbursement for expenses
n. an amount added or deducted on the basis of qualifying circumstances
n. a permissible difference; allowing some freedom to move within limits
allowance.translation: n. 津贴, 零用钱, 限额, 折扣, 允许\nvt. 定量供应

examples.en: My dad gives me an allowance of $10 a week.
examples.zh: 我爸一周给我10块零用钱。

examples.en: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。

alloy.definition: n. a mixture containing two or more metallic elements or metallic and nonmetallic elements usually fused together or dissolving into each other when molten\nv. make an alloy of
alloy.translation: n. 合金\nvt. 将...铸成合金, 减低成色\nvi. 合铸

examples.en: This woman is of gold and silver, not an alloy.
Cast iron is an alloy of iron and carbon.
Electrum is a natural alloy of gold and silver.

ally.definition: n. a friendly nation\nn. an associate who provides cooperation or assistance\nv. become an ally or associate, as by a treaty or marriage
ally.translation: n. 同盟者, 同盟国, 助手\nvt. 使联盟, 使联合, 使有关系\nvi. 结盟

examples.en: Algeria is a close ally of both Russia and China.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚是俄罗斯和中国的亲密盟友。

examples.en: Ally loves playing with her twin sister Anne.
examples.zh: Ally喜欢和她的双胞胎妹妹Anne一起玩。

examples.en: Germany was once an ally of Italy.
examples.zh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。

almost.definition: r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but

examples.en: This cat here is almost as fat as that one.
examples.zh: 这里这只猫跟那里那只差不多一样灵敏。

examples.en: I have been living in Canada for almost five years.
examples.zh: 我在加拿大生活了近五年。

examples.en: Almost stepped on a gecko while going to the metro.
examples.zh: 去地铁的路上差点踩到一只壁虎。

alone.definition:
s. isolated from others
s. lacking companions or companionship
s. exclusive of anyone or anything else
s. radically distinctive and without equal
alone.translation: a. 孤独的, 单独的, 独自的\nadv. 独自地

examples.en: I used to play alone when I was a child.
examples.zh: 我小时候常常独自玩耍。

examples.en: I don't know how to say it, let alone you!
examples.zh: 连我都不知道怎么说，更别说你了！

examples.en: She warned him not to go out at night alone.
examples.zh: 她警告他晚上不要一个人出去。

along.definition:
r. with a forward motion
r. in accompaniment or as a companion
r. to a more advanced state
r. in addition (usually followed by `with')
along.translation: adv. 平行地, 向前\nprep. 沿着

examples.en: He wants to come along with us to the movie.
examples.zh: 他想和我们一起去看电影。

examples.en: Go along this street and turn right at the bank.
examples.zh: 请沿着这条路走，在银行那里向右转。

examples.en: Mary did not get along well with the other girls.
examples.zh: 玛丽和其他女生处得不太好。

alongside.translation: adv. 在旁边, 靠拢着\nprep. 在...旁边, 与...在一起

examples.en: Native Chinese people are working alongside foreigners to change the culture of Shanghai.
examples.zh: 本地人、外来人齐心共创上海新文明。

already.definition: r. prior to a specified or implied time

examples.en: It's already very late, but he is still at work.
examples.zh: 已经很晚了，但是他还在工作。

examples.en: By the time we had arrived, it was already dark.
examples.zh: 我们到的时候天已经黑了。

examples.en: It's already been two weeks since I saw you last.
examples.zh: 我已经两周没有见过您了。

also.translation: adv. 也, 并且, 同样地

examples.en: Love is not just a feeling, but also an art.
examples.zh: 所谓爱，并不仅仅是一种情感，也是一种艺术。

examples.en: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.
examples.zh: 天气又冷又湿。

examples.en: Bob plays not only the guitar but also the flute.
examples.zh: Bob不仅会弹吉他还会吹笛。

alter.definition: v. make an alteration to\nv. remove the ovaries of

examples.en: He's proposing a suggestion for altering the research method.
examples.zh: 他提出改革研究方法的意见。

examples.en: The image was digitally altered.
examples.zh: 这张图片经过数位修改。

examples.en: Meanwhile, conditions have drastically altered.
examples.zh: 在这期间，情况发生了巨大变化。

alternate.definition:
v. go back and forth; swing back and forth between two states or conditions
v. exchange people temporarily to fulfill certain jobs and functions
v. do something in turns
s. every second one of a series
alternate.translation: a. 交替的, 轮流的, 间隔的\nv. 轮流, (使)交替

examples.en: Please list alternate dates.
examples.zh: 请列出备选日期。

alternative.definition: s. necessitating a choice between mutually exclusive possibilities\ns. pertaining to unconventional choices
alternative.translation: n. 两者择一, 供替代的选择\na. 两者择一的, 供选择的\n[计] 选择对象

examples.en: Don't include multiple alternative words inside the same sentence.
examples.zh: 在同一句中不要包含多个可选单词。

examples.en: We have the alternative of death and submission.
examples.zh: 我们要选择是死亡还是臣服。

examples.en: They had no alternative but to retreat.
examples.zh: 他们不得不后撤。

although.definition: conj. Grant all this; be it that; supposing that;\n   notwithstanding; though.

examples.en: Although he is not a singer, he has beautiful voice.
examples.zh: 他虽然不是歌手，但他唱的非常优美。

examples.en: Although it was still early, it was already hot outside.
examples.zh: 虽然时间好早，天气已经热了。

examples.en: Although studying Chinese seems difficult, it's simpler than you think.
examples.zh: 尽管中文学起来不容易，可是比你想的简单。

altitude.definition: n. elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface\nn. the perpendicular distance from the base of a geometric figure to the opposite vertex (or side if parallel)
altitude.translation: n. 高度, 海拔, 高处\n[电] 高度

examples.en: The plane flew at an altitude of 3,000 meters.
examples.zh: 飞机在三千米的高空飞行。

examples.en: The barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, especially used to study climate and to determine altitudes.
examples.zh: 气压表是一种用来测量大气压力的仪器，主要用于研究气候和测量高度。

altogether.definition: r. with everything included or counted
altogether.translation: adv. 完全地, 总而言之

examples.en: That is not altogether false.
examples.zh: 那不全是错的。

examples.en: He doesn't altogether trust me.
examples.zh: 他并不完全信任我。

examples.en: That isn't altogether false.
examples.zh: 那不全是错的。

aluminum.definition: n. a silvery ductile metallic element found primarily in bauxite

examples.en: The aluminum castings must be brushed again.
examples.zh: 这个铝铸件需要重刷一遍.

always.definition: r. at all times; all the time and on every occasion\nr. at any time or in any event\nr. forever; throughout all time

examples.en: I always got up early when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我小时总是很早起床。

examples.en: When in a bus, I always sit at the front.
examples.zh: 在巴士里，我总是坐在前面。

examples.en: I always knew I was born to do this work.
examples.zh: 我一直都知道我生来就是为了做这工作。

amateur.definition: n. someone who pursues a study or sport as a pastime\nn. an athlete who does not play for pay\ns. engaged in as a pastime
amateur.translation: n. 业余爱好者, 外行, 爱好者\n[电] 业余家

examples.en: I was still an amateur at that time.
examples.zh: 我那时还是个外行。

examples.en: My uncle is an amateur cricket player.
examples.zh: 我的舅舅爱好打板球。

examples.en: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.
examples.zh: 外行谈策略，内行谈后勤。

examples.en: It amazed us that she had been to Brazil alone.
examples.zh: 让我们惊讶的是她独自去过巴西。

examples.en: We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
examples.zh: 进口数量的急速增长让我们感到惊讶。

examples.en: Hsiao-ting looked amazing in that dress yesterday — she totally lit up.
examples.zh: 小婷昨天穿那件洋装超好看，整个人亮起来耶。

ambassador.definition: n. a diplomat of the highest rank; accredited as representative from one country to another\nn. an informal representative
ambassador.translation: n. 大使\n[法] 大使, 使节, 代理

examples.en: The English ambassador demanded to meet with the President directly.
examples.zh: 英国大使要求直接会见总统。

examples.en: I have spoken with the Polish ambassador.
examples.zh: 我和波兰大使说了话。

examples.en: I talked with the Polish ambassador.
examples.zh: 我和波兰大使说了话。

ambiguous.definition: a. having more than one possible meaning\ns. having no intrinsic or objective meaning; not organized in conventional patterns
ambiguous.translation: a. 不明确的, 模棱两可的\n[法] 意思含糊的, 模棱两可的, 暧昧的

examples.en: This sentence is ambiguous.
examples.zh: 此句有歧义

ambition.definition: n. a cherished desire\nn. a strong drive for success\nv. have as one's ambition

examples.en: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
examples.zh: 以前，玛丽想和一位有雄心壮志的男人结婚。

examples.en: His ambition was blasted by these repeated failures.
examples.zh: 无数次的失败摧毁了他的雄心壮志。

examples.en: He was a man of great ambition.
examples.zh: 他是个很有野心的人。

ambitious.definition: a. having a strong desire for success or achievement\ns. requiring full use of your abilities or resources
ambitious.translation: a. 有野心的, 抱负不凡的, 雄心勃勃的

examples.en: The difference between bragging and being ambitious is miniscule.
examples.zh: 吹嘘与雄心的差别甚小。

examples.en: I'm someone ambitious - someone who knows very well what he is after.
examples.zh: 我是有志向的人——清楚自己的目标。

examples.en: I'm someone ambitious - someone who knows very well what she is after.
examples.zh: 我是有志向的人——清楚自己的目标。

ambulance.definition: n. a vehicle that takes people to and from hospitals
ambulance.translation: n. 救护车\n[医] 救护车

examples.en: Please get here with the ambulance quickly. Hurry up!
examples.zh: 请你们快点来一辆救护车，快！

examples.en: Tom bought an old ambulance and converted it into a camper.
examples.zh: 汤姆买了一辆旧救护车，并把它改装成露营车。

examples.en: Hang on. The ambulance will get here in just a little bit.
examples.zh: 挺住。救护车马上就来了。

amend.translation: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良\nvi. 改过自新

examples.en: I am not without my shortcomings, but these shortcomings can easily be amended.
examples.zh: 我是个有缺点的人，但这些缺点很容易就能被改正。

amendment.definition: n. the act of amending or correcting\nn. a statement that is added to or revises or improves a proposal or document (a bill or constitution etc.)
amendment.translation: n. 修订, 改善, 改良, 改正\n[化] 调理剂; 修正

examples.en: It's not every day that Congress ratifies a new amendment.
Some claim that full-body scanners violate the Fourth Amendment.
The 14th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution was ratified in 1868.

amid.definition: prep. See Amidst.\nprep. In the midst or middle of; surrounded or encompassed by;\n   among.
amid.translation: prep. 在其间, 在其中\n[经] 在...中

examples.en: There's a fear that the snow will strengthen amid the strong winter pressure pattern.
examples.zh: 人们担心在强劲的冬季气压模式下，降雪量会增加。

examples.en: He is numbered among the greatest scientists in the world.
examples.zh: 他是世界上最伟大的科学家之一。

examples.en: He believes that there is a spy among us.
examples.zh: 他认为我们当中有一个奸细。

examples.en: The three boys had only two dollars among them.
examples.zh: 三个男孩合共只有两元。

amount.definition: n. the relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion\nv. be tantamount or equivalent to
amount.translation: n. 总数, 总额\nvi. 总计, 等同

examples.en: A large amount of money was spent on the bridge.
examples.zh: 建这条桥花了不少钱。

examples.en: I have a certain amount of money on me.
examples.zh: 我有些钱。

examples.en: He would be paid a small amount of money.
examples.zh: 他会拿到一小笔钱。

ample.definition: a. more than enough in size or scope or capacity\ns. affording an abundant supply\ns. fairly large
ample.translation: a. 大量的, 充足的, 丰富的

examples.en: We have ample time to catch our train.
examples.zh: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。

examples.en: He has ample experience.
examples.zh: 他经验丰富。
