amplify.translation: vt. 增强, 放大, 扩大, 详述\nvi. 引伸

examples.en: I just want to amplify my understanding of the world.
It was a mistake to amplify this debate with thoughtless responses.
Criticism from others amplifies the insecurities that constantly haunt me.

amuse.definition: v. occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion\nv. make (somebody) laugh
amuse.translation: vt. 消遣, 娱乐, 使发笑

examples.en: We were all greatly amused by his jokes.
examples.zh: 我们都被他的笑话逗得很开心。

examples.en: We were all amused with the comedy.
examples.zh: 我们都被这出喜剧逗乐了。

examples.en: His story amused everyone.
examples.zh: 他的故事把大家给逗乐了。

analogy.definition: n. an inference that if things agree in some respects they probably agree in others\nn. drawing a comparison in order to show a similarity in some respect
analogy.translation: n. 相似, 类似\n[计] 模拟

examples.en: I see no analogy between your problem and mine.
Such an analogy is inappropriate in this case.
Mary tried to explain fractions to Tom by using a pie as an analogy.

analyse.definition:
v consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
v break down into components or essential features
v make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features
v subject to psychoanalytic treatment
analyse.translation: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解\n[经] 分析

examples.en: The council held a meeting to analyse the rescheduling.
You cannot analyse the data efficiently unless you draw a plot.
Together we'll analyse the phenomenon of violence against women.

analysis.definition:
n. an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole
n. the abstract separation of a whole into its constituent parts in order to study the parts and their relations
n. a form of literary criticism in which the structure of a piece of writing is analyzed
n. the use of closed-class words instead of inflections: e.g., `the father of the bride' instead of `the bride's father'
analysis.translation: n. 分析\n[计] 分析机; 分析员; 分析; 分析程序

examples.en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
examples.zh: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。

examples.en: She persists in saying that her analysis is correct.
examples.zh: 她坚持认为自己的分析是正确的。

examples.en: She maintains that her analysis is correct.
examples.zh: 她坚持自己的分析是正确的。

analyst.definition: n. someone who is skilled at analyzing data\nn. an expert who studies financial data (on credit or securities or sales or financial patterns etc.) and recommends appropriate business actions\nn. a licensed practitioner of psychoanalysis
analyst.translation: n. 分析者, 精神分析学家\n[化] 分析员; 化验员

examples.en: Some analysts consider Somalia as the failed state par excellence.
examples.zh: 一些分析家认为索马里是非常失败的国家。

examples.en: Tom is a financial analyst.
examples.zh: 汤姆是一名金融分析师。

ancestor.definition: n. someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)

examples.en: Our ancestors used animals to name the years of people's births as their lives were closely connected to these animals.
examples.zh: 以动物命名人的属相，是因为我们的先民与这些动物有密切关系。

examples.en: She weaves her baskets in the same style as her ancestors who lived in the desert and harvested fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 她编织的篮子的样式，与她生活在沙漠中收获水果和蔬​​菜的祖先相同。

anchor.definition:
n. a mechanical device that prevents a vessel from moving
n. a central cohesive source of support and stability
n. a television reporter who coordinates a broadcast to which several correspondents contribute
v. fix firmly and stably
anchor.translation: n. 锚\nvt. 抛锚停泊, 使固定\n[计] 锚

examples.en: The boat is attached to the anchor by a chain.
Tom has an anchor tattooed on his right arm.
I have a tattoo of an anchor on my right arm.

ancient.definition:
n. a very old person
n. a person who lived in ancient times
s. belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
s. very old
ancient.translation: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的

examples.en: Rome is one of the most ancient cities in Europe.
examples.zh: 罗马是欧洲最古典的城市之一。

examples.en: The Heavenly Timber Immolation is a kind of ancient ritual.
examples.zh: 燔柴祭天是一种古老的仪式。

examples.en: The giant panda is a surviving ancient animal species.
examples.zh: 大熊猫是一种残存的古动物。

and.definition:
conj. A particle which expresses the relation of connection or
   addition. It is used to conjoin a word with a word, a clause with a
   clause, or a sentence with a sentence.
conj. In order to; -- used instead of the infinitival to,
   especially after try, come, go.
conj. It is sometimes, in old songs, a mere expletive.
conj. If; though. See An, conj.
and.translation: conj. 和, 与\n[计] 与

examples.en: A man came over and asked if I was OK.
examples.zh: 一个男人过来问我怎么了。

examples.en: I may give up soon and just take a nap.
examples.zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

examples.en: We have a lot of rain in June and July.
examples.zh: 六七月份雨很多。

anger.definition:
n. a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance
n. the state of being angry
v. make angry
v. become angry
anger.translation: n. 忿怒\nvt. 激怒, 使发怒\nvi. 发怒

examples.en: Anger me again, I might just peel your skin off.
examples.zh: 再惹我生气，小心我扒了你的皮！

examples.en: She threw off her shoes and socks in anger.
examples.zh: 她很生气地把鞋子，袜子脱掉。

examples.en: He who is slow to anger has great understanding.
examples.zh: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明。

angle.definition:
n. the space between two lines or planes that intersect; the inclination of one line to another; measured in degrees or radians
n. a member of a Germanic people who conquered England and merged with the Saxons and Jutes to become Anglo-Saxons
v. move or proceed at an angle
v. fish with a hook
angle.translation: n. 角, 角度, 角落\nvi. 钓鱼, 谋取, 博取, 斜向移动, 转变角度\nvt. 使转动角度, 在...钓鱼, 获取

examples.en: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
examples.zh: 90度的角叫直角。

examples.en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
examples.zh: 这两条线成直角相交。

examples.en: The angle would be too narrow.
examples.zh: 这个角度会过于狭窄。

angry.definition: a. feeling or showing anger\ns. (of the elements) as if showing violent anger\ns. severely inflamed and painful
angry.translation: a. 生气的, 愤怒的

examples.en: He was so angry as to be unable to speak.
examples.zh: 他气得说不出话来了。

examples.en: He must be very angry to say such a thing.
examples.zh: 他一定是十分生气了，不然他不会说出这样的话来的。

examples.en: He made me so angry that I got a headache.
examples.zh: 他让我气得头疼了。

animal.definition: n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement\ns. marked by the appetites and passions of the body

examples.en: A tiger is a very ferocious kind of animal.
examples.zh: 老虎是一种非常凶猛的动物。

examples.en: Man is the only animal that can make use of fire.
examples.zh: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。

examples.en: Life in prison is worse than the life of an animal.
examples.zh: 监狱生活比做畜牲还不如。

ankle.definition: n. a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus
ankle.translation: n. 踝\n[医] 踝, 踝关节

examples.en: A sprained ankle disabled him from walking for a month.
examples.zh: 他把足踝扭伤了，整整一个月不能走路。

examples.en: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
examples.zh: 她锻炼时扭伤了脚踝。

examples.en: Ankle, ankle, where are you?
examples.zh: 脚踝脚踝你在哪里？

anniversary.definition: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)

examples.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
examples.zh: 汤姆从没忘记在婚礼周年纪念日送给他妻子花。

examples.en: Next month is their 50th anniversary, and they're planning on renewing their vows.
examples.zh: 下个月是他们的五十周年纪念，他们打算重新宣誓。

examples.en: Tuesday marked the final day of the Diamond Jubilee celebrations, marking the 60th anniversary of Queen Elizabeth II's accession to the throne.
examples.zh: 星期二是女王登基钻石庆典的最后一天，标志著伊莉莎白二世女王登基 60 周年。

announce.definition:
v. make known; make an announcement
v. announce publicly or officially
v. give the names of
v. foreshadow or presage
announce.translation: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告\nvi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选

examples.en: Tom found a new way to announce his news.
examples.zh: 汤姆发现了一种宣布他新闻的新方法。

examples.en: In the first place, I would like to announce several new regulations.
examples.zh: 首先，我想宣布几条新制度。

examples.en: Toyota Corporation announced that it would cut 1,000 positions this year.
examples.zh: 丰田公司宣布将会在今年裁员一千人。

announcement.definition: n. a formal public statement\nn. a public statement containing information about an event that has happened or is going to happen
announcement.translation: n. 公告, 发表, 告知\n[经] 通告, 布告, 公告

examples.en: The timing of the announcement hurts the public relations of the police.
examples.zh: 声明的时机对警察的公众关系不利。

annoy.definition: v. cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations

examples.en: He made mistakes on purpose to annoy me.
examples.zh: 他为了惹恼我故意犯错。

examples.en: You simply cannot reason with her, which is quite annoying.
examples.zh: 她就是不讲道理。讨厌死了。

examples.en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
examples.zh: 我父母整天都在为鸡毛蒜皮的事情吵架，真是烦死人了！

annual.definition:
n. (botany) a plant that completes its entire life cycle within the space of a year
n. a reference book that is published regularly once every year
a. completing its life cycle within a year
s. occurring or payable every year
annual.translation: n. 年刊, 年报\na. 每年的, 一年一次的, 全年的, 一年生的

examples.en: I don't know my father's annual income.
examples.zh: 我不知到我爸的年收入是多少。

examples.en: The Easter Egg Roll is an annual event that is held on the lawn of the White House each Easter Monday.
examples.zh: 复活节滚彩蛋活动每年复活节周一都会在白宫的草地上举行。

examples.en: I counted. A pine tree like this has over three hundred annual rings, yet it took only 15 minutes to cut it down.
examples.zh: 我数了一下，这样一棵松树有三百多圈年轮。而砍倒它只需要15分钟。

anonymous.definition: a. having no known name or identity or known source\ns. not known or lacking marked individuality
anonymous.translation: a. 姓氏不详的, 无名的, 无特色的\n[计] 无记录

examples.en: The questions will not take long, and everything would be kept completely anonymous.
examples.zh: 问题不需要占用很多时间，也完全不要留名。

examples.en: You want to remain anonymous.
examples.zh: 你想保持匿名身份。

another.definition: s. any of various alternatives; some other
another.translation: a. 另外的, 再一的, 不同的\npron. 又一个, 另一个, 类似的另一个

examples.en: To say is one thing, and to do quite another.
examples.zh: 说的是一套，做的又是一套。

examples.en: He often says that we need to help one another.
examples.zh: 他常说我们要互帮互助。

examples.en: Another step, and you would have fallen down the stairs.
examples.zh: 再走一步的话，你就已经跌下楼梯了。

answer.definition:
n. a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation
n. the speech act of replying to a question
n. the principal pleading by the defendant in response to plaintiff's complaint; in criminal law it consists of the defendant's plea of `guilty' or `not guilty' (or nolo contendere); in civil law it must contain denials of all allegations in the plaintiff's complaint that the defendant hopes to controvert and it can contain affirmative defenses or counterclaims
n. a nonverbal reaction
answer.translation:
n. 答案, 回答, 回报, 答辩
vt. 回答, 反驳, 适应, 响应, 符合
vi. 回答, 答应, 负责, 符合, 成功
[计] 用户问题及答案新闻组

examples.en: If I gave no answer, I would not have spoken.
examples.zh: 如果我没有给予任何回答，我不会说话。

examples.en: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.
examples.zh: 他觉得我理所应当知道答案。

examples.en: Even if I knew the answer, I wouldn't tell you.
examples.zh: 即使我知道答案，我也不会告诉你。

anticipate.definition:
v. act in advance of; deal with ahead of time
v. realize beforehand
v. be excited or anxious about
v. be a forerunner of or occur earlier than
anticipate.translation: vt. 预期, 占先, 加速, 提前使用\n[医] 提前出现, 先期发生

examples.en: We do not anticipate their buying a new car.
examples.zh: 我们认为他们不会买新车。

examples.en: I anticipate that there will be trouble.
examples.zh: 我预料会有麻烦。

examples.en: I've been anticipating his arrival.
examples.zh: 他到我期待。

anxiety.definition: n. (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic\nn. a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune
anxiety.translation: n. 焦虑, 忧虑, 令人焦虑的事\n[医] 焦虑

examples.en: The way to solve pre-exam anxiety is to start learning now.
examples.zh: 解决考前焦虑的办法是立刻开始学习。

examples.en: He caused his parents a lot of anxiety.
examples.zh: 他让父母很担心。

examples.en: She has anxiety for your safety.
examples.zh: 她担心你的安全。

anxious.definition: s. eagerly desirous\ns. causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
anxious.translation: a. 忧虑的, 发愁的, 渴望的

examples.en: He was very anxious on the eve of the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前夕，他特别焦虑。

examples.en: I am anxious to visit Britain once again.
examples.zh: 我好想快点再去英国。

examples.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
examples.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

any.definition: s. one or some or every or all without specification\nr. to any degree or extent

examples.en: Did any cute girls talk to you at the bar?
examples.zh: 在酒吧有没有美女找你搭讪？

examples.en: I don't like him any more than he likes me.
examples.zh: 我们之间已经没有感情了。

examples.en: I am not connected to this crime in any way.
examples.zh: 我与这起犯罪没有任何关系。

anybody.definition: n. Any one out of an indefinite number of persons; anyone;\n   any person.\nn. A person of consideration or standing.
anybody.translation: pron. 任何人\nn. 重要人物

examples.en: She can sing better than anybody else in her class.
examples.zh: 她唱歌唱得比班上任何一个人好。

examples.en: Sami looked at himself as somebody smarter than anybody else.
examples.zh: 萨米自认为他比他身边的其他人都聪明。

examples.en: Why would anybody think that was a good idea?
examples.zh: 怎么会有人认为那是个好主意？

anyhow.definition: r. used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; anyhow, they're quiet"; anyway, it's gone"; in any case, there was a brief scuffle"\nr. in any way whatsoever
anyhow.translation: adv. 无论如何, 至少

examples.en: It's too late, anyhow.
examples.zh: 反正已经太晚了。

anyone.definition: n. One taken at random rather than by selection; anybody.\n   [Commonly written as two words.]

examples.en: She told me not to tell anyone, so I didn't.
examples.zh: 她跟我说不要告诉任何人。所以我没有说。

examples.en: "Was anyone with you?" "No, I was on my own."
examples.zh: “有人跟你在一起吗？” “没有，我独自一个人。”

examples.en: Is there anyone who wants to keep the cute kitten?
examples.zh: 有没有人要养可爱的小猫？

anything.definition:
n. Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatever; thing of
   any kind; something or other; aught; as, I would not do it for
   anything.
n. Expressing an indefinite comparison; -- with as or like.
adv. In any measure; anywise; at all.

examples.en: I was too tired to care for anything but bed.
examples.zh: 我累得只想躺在床上。

examples.en: I don't have anything else I have to do today.
examples.zh: 我今天没有更多的事要做了。

examples.en: Are you sure you don't want me to say anything?
examples.zh: 你确定要我什么都不说？

anyway.definition: r used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; anyhow, they're quiet"; anyway, it's gone"; in any case, there was a brief scuffle"\nr in any way whatsoever
anyway.translation: adv. 无论如何, 至少

examples.en: Everyone was against it, but Mary and John got married anyway.
examples.zh: 随然大家一致反对，但玛丽和约翰还是结了婚。

examples.en: I don't have a CD player, but I bought the CD anyway.
examples.zh: 我没有 CD 播放机，但还是把唱片买下来了。

examples.en: The lawyer warned his client against testifying, but he did it anyway.
examples.zh: 律师警告过他的当事人反对作证, 但是他还是这么做了。

anywhere.definition: r. at or in or to any place; (`anyplace' is used informally for `anywhere')

examples.en: They looked everywhere for him, but couldn't find him anywhere.
examples.zh: 他们已经到处找过他，可是却哪里也找不到他。

examples.en: You're not going anywhere until your room is clean.
examples.zh: 你要是不收拾好你的房间的话哪儿都别想去。

examples.en: Do you know if there's a steam room anywhere around here?
examples.zh: 你知道这附近哪里有汗蒸房吗？

apart.definition:
s. remote and separate physically or socially
s. having characteristics not shared by others
r. separated or at a distance in place or position or time
r. not taken into account or excluded from consideration
apart.translation: adv. 成零碎, 成距离, 分别地, 分离着\na. 分离的

examples.en: Mr. and Mrs. Smith live apart from each other now.
examples.zh: 史密斯夫妇现在分居了。

examples.en: One day apart seems like a separation of three years.
examples.zh: 一日不见如隔三秋。

examples.en: Apart from my sister, my family doesn't watch TV.
examples.zh: 除了我的妹妹之外，我家人都不看电视。

apartment.definition: n. a suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house

examples.en: How come this fucking apartment has no double-glazing? I'm freezing.
examples.zh: 为什么这个他妈的房子没有双层玻璃，我快要冷死了。

examples.en: How many rooms does she have in her apartment?
examples.zh: 她的公寓有几间房呢？

examples.en: I invited a Chinese friend over to my apartment.
examples.zh: 我请了一位中国朋友来我的公寓。

apologize.definition: v. acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing\nv. defend, explain, clear away, or make excuses for by reasoning

examples.en: All you have to do is apologize for being late.
examples.zh: 你要做的只是为迟到而道歉。

examples.en: I don't see any reason why I have to apologize.
examples.zh: 我没发现任何我该道歉的理由。

examples.en: I apologize for the methods used to get you here.
examples.zh: 我很抱歉用这种方式把你请来。

apology.definition: n. an expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone\nn. a formal written defense of something you believe in strongly\nn. a poor example
apology.translation: n. 道歉, 辩护\n[法] 道歉, 谢罪, 辩解者

examples.en: I must make an apology to her.
examples.zh: 我不得不向她道歉。

examples.en: You owe me an apology for that.
examples.zh: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。

examples.en: Her apology was nothing but show.
examples.zh: 她的道歉都是假的。

apparatus.definition: n. equipment designed to serve a specific function\nn. (anatomy) a group of body parts that work together to perform a given function
apparatus.translation: n. 装置, 器具, 器官\n[化] 仪器; 器械

examples.en: The physics laboratory has the best apparatus I've ever seen.
The fire department dispatched several fire apparatus to the scene.
That school is equipped with the latest gymnastics apparatus.

apparent.definition: s. clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment\ns. appearing as such but not necessarily so
apparent.translation: a. 清晰可见的, 显然的, 表面上的\n[电] 外在的

examples.en: It's in times like these that the character of a person becomes apparent.
examples.zh: 路遥知马力，日久见人心。

apparently.translation: adv. 表面上, 清楚地, 显然地

examples.en: Apparently, they nest in a tree in front of the house.
examples.zh: 很明显的，他们房前的树上筑巢。

examples.en: Apparently we're just two peas in a pod.
examples.zh: 咱俩也就是一丘之貉。

examples.en: Apparently, there is nothing that cannot happen today.
examples.zh: 显然，今天什么事都有可能发生。

appeal.definition:
n. attractiveness that interests or pleases or stimulates
n. (law) a legal proceeding in which the appellant resorts to a higher court for the purpose of obtaining a review of a lower court decision and a reversal of the lower court's judgment or the granting of a new trial
v. take a court case to a higher court for review
v. request earnestly (something from somebody); ask for aid or protection
appeal.translation: n. 恳求, 诉请, 上诉, 吸引力\nvi. 呼吁, 诉请, 要求, 上诉, 有吸引力\nvt. 将...上诉

examples.en: His music and words appeal to young people.
examples.zh: 他的曲和词都很受年轻人欢迎。

examples.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
examples.zh: 被告会向上级法院上诉。

examples.en: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
examples.zh: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。

appear.definition:
v. come into sight or view
v. be issued or published
v. seem to be true, probable, or apparent
v. come into being or existence, or appear on the scene
appear.translation: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到\n[法] 出庭, 到案, 出现

examples.en: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
examples.zh: 说曹操，曹操就到。

examples.en: The accused is to appear before the court on Friday.
examples.zh: 被告周五将会出现在法庭上。

examples.en: Do I appear to look like I am rich?
examples.zh: 我看起来很有钱吗？

appearance.definition:
n. outward or visible aspect of a person or thing
n. the event of coming into sight
n. formal attendance (in court or at a hearing) of a party in an action
n. a mental representation
appearance.translation: n. 出现, 露面, 外观, 外表, 出版\n[计] 外观, 版面

examples.en: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
examples.zh: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

examples.en: An eclipse of the sun is a rare appearance.
examples.zh: 日蚀只会偶尔发生。

examples.en: Judging from her appearance, I think that she's rich.
examples.zh: 从她的外表上看，我想她大半是个有钱人。

appetite.definition: n. a feeling of craving something
appetite.translation: n. 食欲, 欲望, 爱好\n[医] 食欲

examples.en: After skiing, I find that I have a voracious appetite.
examples.zh: 滑完雪后，我发现我食欲大增。

examples.en: The sight of fresh lobster gave me an appetite.
examples.zh: 看见新鲜龙虾，我有了食欲。

examples.en: A little walk will give you a good appetite for breakfast.
examples.zh: 散散步将会给你很好的食欲吃早餐。

applaud.definition: v. clap one's hands or shout after performances to indicate approval\nv. express approval of
applaud.translation: v. 拍手喝彩, 称赞, 赞同

examples.en: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.
examples.zh: 所有的观众都站起来鼓掌。

examples.en: When I entered the house, they all applauded.
examples.zh: 我进屋的时候，他们都鼓掌了。

examples.en: As I entered the room, they applauded.
examples.zh: 我进屋的时候，他们都鼓掌了。

apple.definition: n. fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh\nn. native Eurasian tree widely cultivated in many varieties for its firm rounded edible fruits
apple.translation: n. 苹果, 家伙\n[医] 苹果

examples.en: I delight in going to the apple orchard each fall.
examples.zh: 我乐意每年秋季去苹果园。

examples.en: Sometimes being overcautious in planning could upset the apple cart.
examples.zh: 计划时如果过于谨慎的话，可能会反把计划搞乱。

examples.en: Can I have a piece of this apple pie?
examples.zh: 我可以吃一块苹果派吗？

appliance.definition: n. a device or control that is very useful for a particular job\nn. durable goods for home or office use
appliance.translation: n. 器械, 用具, 应用\n[医] 矫正器; 器

examples.en: This is an appliance for drying clothes.
examples.zh: 这是一个晾衣服的器具。

applicable.definition: s. capable of being applied; having relevance
applicable.translation: a. 合适的, 可应用的\n[法] 适用的, 适应的

examples.en: This law is applicable to all cases.
examples.zh: 此法适用于所有情况。

applicant.definition: n. a person who requests or seeks something such as assistance or employment or admission
applicant.translation: n. 申请者\n[经] 申请人, 请求人, 谋事人

examples.en: Does the applicant have suitable abilities to carry out the job?
examples.zh: 那位求职者能胜任工作吗？

examples.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
examples.zh: 这份职位要求应征者有一定的英语口语表达能力。

examples.en: Delete his name from the list of the applicants.
examples.zh: 从申请单中删除他的名字。

application.definition:
n. the act of bringing something to bear; using it for a particular purpose
n. a verbal or written request for assistance or employment or admission to a school
n. the work of applying something; 
n. a program that gives a computer instructions that provide the user with tools to accomplish a task
application.translation: n. 应用, 申请, 志愿书, 应用程序\n[计] 应用, 应用程序

examples.en: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
examples.zh: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

examples.en: The due date for submitting the application is this Friday.
examples.zh: 提交申请的最后期限是星期五。

examples.en: The infrastructure of an application is directly related to its overall performance.
examples.zh: 一个应用的架构直接关系到它的整体性能。

apply.definition:
v. be pertinent or relevant or applicable
v. ask (for something)
v. refer (a word or name) to a person or thing
v. apply oneself to
apply.translation: vt. 涂, 应用\nvi. 申请, 适用

examples.en: In order to apply, you have to go in person.
examples.zh: 要申请的话，你得亲自去。

examples.en: We could apply the theory of punctuated equilibrium to languages.
examples.zh: 我们可以把间断平衡理论应用到语言上。

examples.en: This rule does not apply in all cases.
examples.zh: 这条规则不是任何情况下都奏效的。

appoint.definition: v. create and charge with a task or function\nv. assign a duty, responsibility or obligation to\nv. furnish
appoint.translation: vt. 任命, 指定, 下令\n[法] 派, 派任, 任命

examples.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
examples.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

examples.en: He came five minutes behind the appointed time.
examples.zh: 他在指定时间的五分钟后到了。

examples.en: They appointed him as a director.
examples.zh: 他们任命他为经理。

appointment.definition:
n. the act of putting a person into a non-elective position
n. (usually plural) furnishings and equipment (especially for a ship or hotel)
n. the job to which you are (or hope to be) appointed
n. (law) the act of disposing of property by virtue of the power of appointment
appointment.translation: n. 约会, 委任的职位, 委派\n[经] 任命, 派, 指定

examples.en: I made an appointment to see him at seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 我和他约了7点钟见面。

examples.en: Mr. Zhu's appointment is around 8:30. Until then, please wait here.
examples.zh: 朱先生的预约在八点半左右。 在那之前，请先在这等待。

examples.en: He was very angry with me when I forgot the appointment.
examples.zh: 当我忘记约定时，他十分愤怒。

appraisal.definition: n. the classification of someone or something with respect to its worth\nn. a document appraising the value of something (as for insurance or taxation)\nn. an expert estimation of the quality, quantity, and other characteristics of someone or something
appraisal.translation: n. 评价, 估价\n[经] 评价, 评估

examples.en: Our quarterly results will serve as the best appraisal of our approach.
The World Bank has begun appraisal of Laos’ controversial Nam Theun II hydroelectric project.
Tom generally makes good decisions based on a realistic appraisal of the situation he's faced with.

appreciate.definition:
v. recognize with gratitude; be grateful for
v. be fully aware of; realize fully
v. gain in value
v. increase the value of
appreciate.translation: vt. 赏识, 鉴别, 为...而感激, 领会, 欣赏\nvi. 增值, 涨价

examples.en: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
examples.zh: 感谢你帮我解释明白。

examples.en: I deeply appreciate your advice and kindness.
examples.zh: 我深深地感激你的建议和好心。

examples.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
examples.zh: 台币上涨，造成台湾的出口贸易萎靡不振。

appreciation.definition: n. understanding of the nature or meaning or quality or magnitude of something\nn. an expression of gratitude\nn. an increase in price or value
appreciation.translation: n. 感激, 赏识, 鉴别\n[经] 涨价, 增值

examples.en: He always comes to show his appreciation during the New Year and holidays.
examples.zh: 过年过节时，他总是来慰劳。

approach.definition:
n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation
n. the act of drawing spatially closer to something
n. the event of one object coming closer to another
n. the temporal property of becoming nearer in time
approach.translation: n. 接近, 入门\nvt. 接近, 近似, 找...商量\nvi. 靠近

examples.en: A true scientist would not approach the question this way.
examples.zh: 真正的科学家不会这样去思考。

examples.en: That's the best approach to the study of English.
examples.zh: 那是学英语最好的方法。

examples.en: He's turning red, because he doesn't know how to approach her.
examples.zh: 他脸红了，不知该怎么接近她。

appropriate.definition: v. take possession of by force, as after an invasion\na. suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc
appropriate.translation: a. 适当的\n[经] 适当的, 拨出, 占用

examples.en: Do you think it's appropriate to talk like that?
examples.zh: 你觉得说这种话合适吗？

examples.en: I need to configure this server with an appropriate firewall system.
examples.zh: 我该在这个服务器上设置一个防火墙。

examples.en: I hear that keeping yourself hydrated at appropriate times can help prevent heatstroke.
examples.zh: 听说适时地补充水分可以预防中暑。

approval.definition: n. a feeling of liking something or someone good\nn. acceptance as satisfactory\nn. a message expressing a favorable opinion
approval.translation: n. 赞成, 批准\n[化] 核准

examples.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
examples.zh: 如果您同意, 我想给他这份工作。

examples.en: He gave me his stamp of approval.
examples.zh: 他给了我正式批准。

examples.en: I am waiting for approval.
examples.zh: 我在等待批准。

approve.definition: v. give sanction to\nv. judge to be right or commendable; think well of
approve.translation: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据\nvi. 赞许

examples.en: I cannot approve of your going out with him.
examples.zh: 我不能让你和他出去。

examples.en: Do you approve of what he is doing?
examples.zh: 他做的事情你赞成的吧？

examples.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
examples.zh: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。

approximate.definition:
v. be close or similar
s. not quite exact or correct
s. very close in resemblance
s. located close together
approximate.translation: a. 大约的, 接近的, 近似的\nvt. 接近, 使接近, 粗略估计\nvi. 接近于

examples.en: This is all very approximate.
examples.zh: 这一切都非常近似。

examples.en: The story approximates to historical truth.
examples.zh: 故事与历史真相接近。

apt.definition: s. (usually followed by `to') naturally disposed toward\ns. at risk of or subject to experiencing something usually unpleasant\ns. mentally quick and resourceful
apt.translation: a. 有...倾向的, 易于的, 恰当的, 聪明的\n[计] 自动数控语言, 自动图象传输, 自动程序控制, 自动程序设计工具

examples.en: The rich are apt to look down upon the poor.
examples.zh: 富人往往瞧不起穷人。

examples.en: Young people are apt to go to extremes.
examples.zh: 青年人总爱挑战极端。

examples.en: A careless person is apt to make mistakes.
examples.zh: 粗心大意的人很容易犯错。

arbitrary.definition: a. based on or subject to individual discretion or preference or sometimes impulse or caprice
arbitrary.translation: a. 任意的, 武断的, 专治的, 霸道的

examples.en: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.
examples.zh: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。

examples.en: Godwin's law teaches us that any infinite discussion about an arbitrary subject converges to a Nazi comparison.
examples.zh: 高德温法则告诉我们对任何主题的所有无休止的讨论会趋于和纳粹主义的类比。

arch.definition:
n. a curved shape in the vertical plane that spans an opening
n. a curved bony structure supporting or enclosing organs (especially the inner sides of the feet)
n. a passageway under a curved masonry construction
n. (architecture) a masonry construction (usually curved) for spanning an opening and supporting the weight above it
arch.translation:
n. 拱门, 拱形, 足弓
vt. 使成弓形
vi. 拱起, 成弓形
a. 主要的, 调皮的, 傲慢无礼的, 狡猾的

examples.en: The cat arched its back and stretched itself.
examples.zh: 猫弓起背，伸了个懒腰。

architect.definition: n. someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
architect.translation: n. 建筑师, 设计者, 缔造者

examples.en: You can see that the architect paid scrupulous attention to detail.
examples.zh: 这位建筑师显然是一位无微不至的建筑师。

examples.en: That building's facade is bizarre. No idea what the architect was thinking.
examples.zh: 这座大楼的外观很奇怪，不知道设计师是怎么想的。

examples.en: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.
examples.zh: 尽管有逆境，建筑师还是获得了享誉全球的荣誉。

architecture.definition: n. an architectural product or work\nn. the discipline dealing with the principles of design and construction and ornamentation of fine buildings\nn. the profession of designing buildings and environments with consideration for their esthetic effect
architecture.translation: n. 建筑学, 建筑式样\n[计] 体系结构

examples.en: You like to talk about architecture, don't you?
examples.zh: 你喜欢讨论建筑，不是吗？

examples.en: Sixty-four-bit software will not run on 32-bit architecture.
examples.zh: 64位的软件在32位架构的系统上跑不起来。

examples.en: Rome is famous for its ancient architecture.
examples.zh: 罗马以其古代建筑而闻名。

area.definition:
n. a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)
n. a subject of study
n. a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve
n. a part of a structure having some specific characteristic or function
area.translation: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地\n[计] 区域

examples.en: Do you know of a cheap hotel in the area?
examples.zh: 您知道这附近有便宜的旅馆吗？

examples.en: He is an expert in the area of city planning.
examples.zh: 他是个城市规划的专家。

examples.en: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
examples.zh: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。

arena.definition: n. the central area of an ancient Roman amphitheater where contests and spectacles were held; especially an area that was strewn with sand\nn. a playing field where sports events take place
arena.translation: n. 角斗场, 舞台, 场地\n[医] 尿沉渣, 尿沙; 脑沙

examples.en: Tomorrow the Chinese national team play against the Korean national team in their home arena.
examples.zh: 明天中国国家队主场对阵韩国国家队。

argue.definition: v. present reasons and arguments\nv. have an argument about something\nv. give evidence of
argue.translation: vi. 提出理由, 争论, 辩论\nvt. 主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服

examples.en: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

examples.en: Tom said that he didn't want to waste time arguing.
examples.zh: 汤姆说他不想把时间浪费在争论上。

examples.en: Columbus argued that he could reach India by going west.
examples.zh: 哥伦布提出，向西航行可以到达印度。

argument.definition:
n. a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true
n. a discussion in which reasons are advanced for and against some proposition or proposal
n. a summary of the subject or plot of a literary work or play or movie
n. (computer science) a reference or value that is passed to a function, procedure, subroutine, command, or program
argument.translation: n. 争论, 论证, 论据, 自变量\n[计] 参数

examples.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
examples.zh: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。

examples.en: An argument may be logically sound without being true.
examples.zh: 不正确的命题听起来可能符合逻辑。

examples.en: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
examples.zh: 经过长久的争论，我终于说服了她去露营。

arise.definition: v. originate or come into being\nv. rise to one's feet\nv. result or issue
arise.translation: vi. 站立, 出现, 起来

examples.en: Heroes arise in troubled times.
examples.zh: 乱世出英雄。

examples.en: The accident arose from a simple mistake.
examples.zh: 事故由一个简单的错误产生。

examples.en: Then arose the question of where we were to get the necessary machinery.
examples.zh: 于是出现了一个问题，哪里能找我们需要的机器。

arithmetic.definition: n. the branch of pure mathematics dealing with the theory of numerical calculations
arithmetic.translation: n. 算术, 算术知识\n[机] 算术; 算术的

examples.en: How many arithmetic books are left?
examples.zh: 有多少本算数书留着？

examples.en: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.
examples.zh: 准确性在计算中很重要。

examples.en: Arithmetic deals with numbers.
examples.zh: 算数处理数字。

arm.definition:
n. a human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb
n. any projection that is thought to resemble a human arm
n. the part of an armchair or sofa that supports the elbow and forearm of a seated person
v. prepare oneself for a military confrontation
arm.translation:
n. 手臂, 袖子, 狭长港湾, 武器
vt. 武装, 装备
vi. 武装起来
[计] 异步应答方式; 自动货品销路管理

examples.en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
examples.zh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

examples.en: I caught him by the arm before he could fall.
examples.zh: 在他倒下前我抓住了他的手臂。

examples.en: Tom broke some bones in his arm and hand.
examples.zh: 汤姆的手臂和手断了些骨头。

army.definition: n. a permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state\nn. a large number of people united for some specific purpose

examples.en: The government should strengthen their army once and for all!
examples.zh: 政府应该彻底加强军队建设！

examples.en: A great number of citizens went into the army.
examples.zh: 许多老百姓加入了军队。

examples.en: The town was defended by a large army.
examples.zh: 城市由一支大军守卫。

around.definition:
r. by a circular or circuitous route
r. in a circle or circular motion
r. to a particular destination either specified or understood
r. in circumference
around.translation: prep. 包围, 在...周围, 四处\nadv. 兜着圈子, 在附近, 到处

examples.en: You had better not walk around in such a place.
examples.zh: 你最好别在那种地方走来走去。

examples.en: He's a regular at the bars and pubs around here.
examples.zh: 他是这里附近酒吧和酒馆的常客。

examples.en: She has a great wish to travel around the world.
examples.zh: 她有一个很大的愿望，就是环游世界。

arouse.definition: v. call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)\nv. to begin moving, "As the thunder started the sleeping children began to stir"\nv. stimulate sexually
arouse.translation: vt. 唤醒, 鼓励, 引起\nvi. 醒来

examples.en: How to arouse a woman's desire?
examples.zh: 如何引起女人的渴望？

examples.en: Coffee does not arouse my interest.
examples.zh: 咖啡不能引起我的兴趣。

examples.en: Today's Beijing has given me a very deep impression and aroused my curiosity.
examples.zh: 现代的北京给了我深刻的印象，也激起了我的好奇心。

arrange.definition:
v. put into a proper or systematic order
v. make arrangements for
v. adapt for performance in a different way
v. arrange thoughts, ideas, temporal events
arrange.translation: v. 安排, 排列, 达成协议\n[计] 重排

examples.en: In the afternoon I must arrange for the trip.
examples.zh: 下午我必须为旅行做准备了。

examples.en: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
examples.zh: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。

examples.en: A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
examples.zh: 旅行社会为你安排去安达卢西亚的旅行。

arrangement.definition: n. an orderly grouping (of things or persons) considered as a unit; the result of arranging\nn. an organized structure for arranging or classifying\nn. the act of arranging and adapting a piece of music
arrangement.translation: n. 排列, 整齐, 安排\n[计] 排列

examples.en: Flower arrangement is a part of Japanese culture.
examples.zh: 花道是日本文化的一部分。

examples.en: Arrangements have already been made.
examples.zh: 已经安排好了。

array.definition:
n. an orderly arrangement
n. an impressive display
n. especially fine or decorative clothing
n. an arrangement of aerials spaced to give desired directional characteristics
array.translation: n. 排列, 衣服, 大批, 军队\nvt. 布署, 打扮, 排列\n[计] 数组; 阵列

examples.en: The trigonometric functions satisfy a wide array of notable algebraic identities.
examples.zh: 三角函数满足各种代数恒等式。

examples.en: Behind every animal on the Chinese zodiac lies an array of proverbs, sayings and stories.
examples.zh: 每一个生肖的背后都有著数不尽的成语、谚语和故事。

arrest.definition: n. the state of inactivity following an interruption
arrest.translation: n. 逮捕, 监禁\nvt. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止

examples.en: I didn't know that Tom was going to be arrested.
examples.zh: 我不知道汤姆要被逮捕了。

examples.en: The police arrested the man who had murdered the girl.
examples.zh: 警察逮捕了谋杀这位小姐的凶手。

examples.en: The police are believed to have arrested the wrong woman.
examples.zh: 警察被认为抓错了一个女人。

arrival.definition: n. accomplishment of an objective\nn. the act of arriving at a certain place\nn. someone who arrives (or has arrived)
arrival.translation: n. 到达, 抵达, 到达者\n[经] 到达, 到达物

examples.en: I will notify you of the arrival of the goods.
examples.zh: 货物运到，我会通知你们的。

examples.en: On his arrival at the station, he called a taxi.
examples.zh: 他到了火车站，就叫了辆出租车。

examples.en: On his arrival in London, he sent me a telegram.
examples.zh: 他一到伦敦就给我发了个电报。

arrive.definition: v. reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress\nv. succeed in a big way; get to the top

examples.en: Please send me a letter as soon as you arrive.
examples.zh: 你到了之后请马上给我写一封信。

examples.en: We'll contact you by phone as soon as we arrive.
examples.zh: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。

examples.en: If you start at once you'll arrive by six o'clock.
examples.zh: 如果你现在马上出发，六时之前就可以到达。

arrogant.definition: s. having or showing feelings of unwarranted importance out of overbearing pride
arrogant.translation: a. 自大的, 傲慢的

examples.en: That girl is arrogant because of her beauty.
examples.zh: 那位女生对自己的美貌感到很骄傲。

examples.en: I couldn't put up with her arrogant behavior.
examples.zh: 我无法忍受她傲慢的态度。

examples.en: Can one be honest without appearing arrogant?
examples.zh: 一个人能否在不显得傲慢的情况下保持诚实？

arrow.definition: n. a mark to indicate a direction or relation\nn. a projectile with a straight thin shaft and an arrowhead on one end and stabilizing vanes on the other; intended to be shot from a bow
arrow.translation: n. 箭, 箭状物, 箭头记号

examples.en: Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.
examples.zh: 光阴飞逝如箭; 果蝇喜欢香蕉。

examples.en: Time flies like an arrow, and fruit flies like bananas.
examples.zh: 光阴飞似箭，水果飞似蕉。

examples.en: He shot an arrow at the deer.
examples.zh: 他射了鹿一箭。

art.definition: n. the products of human creativity; works of art collectively\nn. the creation of beautiful or significant things\nn. a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation
art.translation: n. 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术\n[计] 实际保持时间, 特许权和资源表, 平均检索时间, 平均运行时间

examples.en: I don't know how to use an art file (.art).
examples.zh: 我不知道如何使用.art文件。

examples.en: Love is not just a feeling, but also an art.
examples.zh: 所谓爱，并不仅仅是一种情感，也是一种艺术。

examples.en: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.
examples.zh: 她在夜校上自卫术课程。

article.definition:
n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
n. one of a class of artifacts
n. a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will)
n. (grammar) a determiner that may indicate the specificity of reference of a noun phrase
article.translation: n. 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约\n[计] 信件

examples.en: The article begins with an account of the current situation.
examples.zh: 文章开头讲了当前的形势。

examples.en: The article on Buddhism revived my interest in oriental religions.
examples.zh: 那篇关于佛教的文章再次勾起了我对东方宗教的兴趣。

examples.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.
examples.zh: 那就是那台他用来写文章的电脑。

artificial.definition: a. contrived by art rather than nature\ns. artificially formal\ns. not arising from natural growth or characterized by vital processes
artificial.translation: a. 人造的, 假的, 非原地产的\n[医] 人工的, 人造的, 伟牟

examples.en: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天将要发射一颗人造卫星。

examples.en: She held a large bouquet of artificial flowers in her hands.
examples.zh: 她手里拿著一大束假花。

examples.en: Today our artificial satellites are revolving around the earth.
examples.zh: 今天我们的人造卫星正在环绕地球运转。

artist.definition: n. a person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination

examples.en: Making a living as a manga artist is almost impossible.
examples.zh: 以漫画家谋生几乎不可能。

examples.en: It is clear that he is a great artist.
examples.zh: 他无庸置疑是个伟大的艺术家。

examples.en: She will be a famous artist in the future.
examples.zh: 她将来会是一个有名的艺术家。

as.definition:
n a very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar
n a United States territory on the eastern part of the island of Samoa
n a metric unit of length equal to one ten billionth of a meter (or 0.0001 micron); used to specify wavelengths of electromagnetic radiation
n any of several fat-soluble vitamins essential for normal vision; prevents night blindness or inflammation or dryness of the eyes
n one of the four nucleotides used in building DNA; all four nucleotides have a common phosphate group and a sugar (ribose)
n (biochemistry) purine base found in DNA and RNA; pairs with thymine in DNA and with uracil in RNA
n the basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
n the 1st letter of the Roman alphabet
n the blood group whose red cells carry the A antigen
r to the same degree (often followed by `as')
as.translation:
adv. 同样地, 例如
prep. 做为, 当作
conj. 当...之时, 以...的方式, 像...一样, 因为
[计] 高级系统, 先进系统, 辅助存储器, 自治系统

examples.en: I was at a loss as to what to say.
examples.zh: 我无话可说。

examples.en: As a boy, I used to swim in the pond.
examples.zh: 我还是个小男孩时常去池塘游泳。

examples.en: I am not so fond of music as you are.
examples.zh: 我没有你那么喜欢音乐。

ascend.definition:
v. travel up, "We ascended the mountain"
v. go back in order of genealogical succession
v. become king or queen
v. appear to be moving upward, as by means of tendrils
ascend.translation: vi. 上升, 追溯, 登高\nvt. 攀登

examples.en: The skyscraper's elevators ascend at an astonishing rate of speed.
The soul must be purified before it can ascend.
He was going to ascend to the throne.

ascertain.definition: v. learn or discover with certainty
ascertain.translation: vt. 确定, 查明\n[法] 查明, 弄清, 确定

examples.en: I am going to ascertain the truth of the matter.
It's difficult to ascertain the meaning of a hapax legomenon.
We will first ascertain the cause of the disaster.

ashamed.definition: a. feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse
ashamed.translation: a. 惭愧的, 羞耻的

examples.en: A man of sense would be ashamed to do so.
examples.zh: 聪明人会羞于干这种事。

examples.en: He is very much ashamed of having behaved so badly.
examples.zh: 他为自己的行为感到非常羞耻。

examples.en: I was ashamed to go out in old clothes.
examples.zh: 穿旧衣服出门令我感觉颜面扫地。

ashore.definition: r. towards the shore from the water

examples.en: The pod of pilot whales washed ashore at Panadura Beach.
Tom and Mary said that they won't go ashore.
His boat was washed ashore on a desert island.

aside.definition:
n. a line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage
r. on or to one side
r. out of the way (especially away from one's thoughts)
r. placed or kept separate and distinct as for a purpose
aside.translation: n. 小声说的话, 旁白\nadv. 在一边, 离开, 另外

examples.en: But you know, I have nothing aside from this.
examples.zh: 但你知道，我除了这些以外一无所有！

examples.en: He pulled aside to let a truck pass.
examples.zh: 他移开，让卡车通过。

examples.en: She put aside the sewing and stood up.
examples.zh: 她放下手中的针线活，并站了起来。

ask.definition:
v. inquire about
v. make a request or demand for something to somebody
v. direct or put; seek an answer to
v. consider obligatory; request and expect
ask.translation: vi. 问, 要求\nvt. 问, 要求, 邀请, 需要

examples.en: Tom is going to ask Mary if she can swim.
examples.zh: 汤姆要问玛莉会不会游泳。

examples.en: I’ll go ask him if he can speak Japanese.
examples.zh: 我问问他会不会说日语。

examples.en: It was foolish of her to ask him for help.
examples.zh: 她去找他帮忙，实在不是一个明智之举。

asleep.definition:
a. in a state of sleep
s. lacking sensation
s. dead
r. into a sleeping state
asleep.translation: a. 睡着的, 长眠的, 麻木的\nadv. 熟睡地

examples.en: I was so excited that I could not fall asleep.
examples.zh: 我兴奋得睡不著觉。

examples.en: I was very tired, so I fell asleep right away.
examples.zh: 我累得很，所以马上就睡著了。

examples.en: Tom fell asleep almost as soon as the movie started.
examples.zh: 汤姆几乎电影开始时睡觉了。

aspect.definition: n. a distinct feature or element in a problem\nn. a characteristic to be considered\nn. the beginning or duration or completion or repetition of the action of a verb
aspect.translation: n. 外观, 方面, 面貌, 方向\n[医] 方面, 局面; 外观

examples.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
examples.zh: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

examples.en: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.
examples.zh: 我们必须从财政方面考虑一下这个计划。

examples.en: Which aspects of Chinese medicine do you specialise in?
examples.zh: 您专攻于中医的什么领域？

aspire.definition: v have an ambitious plan or a lofty goal

examples.en: She aspired to become an actress.
examples.zh: 她立志成为一名演员。

examples.en: Confidence and courage are not exclusively masculine traits—they are values that everyone can aspire to.
examples.zh: 自信与勇气不仅是男性特质，也可以是所有人都能追求的价值。

assault.definition: n. close fighting during the culmination of a military attack\nn. a threatened or attempted physical attack by someone who appears to be able to cause bodily harm if not stopped\nn. thoroughbred that won the triple crown in 1946
assault.translation: n. 攻击, 袭击\nvt. 袭击, 攻击\nvi. 发动攻击

examples.en: They will make an assault on the summit, weather permitting.
Armed with assault rifles, they took more than thirty hostages.
Sami was found guilty of aggravated assault and attempted murder.

assemble.definition: v. create by putting components or members together\nv. get people together
assemble.translation: vt. 集合, 收集, 装配\nvi. 集合\n[计] 汇编

examples.en: I'll keep the instructions you sent for assembling the furniture.
examples.zh: 我会将你传来的家具组装说明记下来。

examples.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
examples.zh: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。

examples.en: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
examples.zh: 这个书架组装起来很简单。

assembly.definition:
n. a group of machine parts that fit together to form a self-contained unit
n. a group of persons who are gathered together for a common purpose
n. a unit consisting of components that have been fitted together
n. the social act of assembling
assembly.translation: n. 与会者, 集会, 装配, 组件\n[化] 装配

examples.en: Tessa shared her experience in a chapel assembly this April.
examples.zh: 今年四月，苔丝在教会集会上分享了她的经验。

examples.en: Where is the assembly point?
examples.zh: 集合地点是哪儿？

assert.definition: v. state categorically\nv. insist on having one's opinions and rights recognized
assert.translation: vt. 主张, 坚称, 断言\n[法] 宣称, 断言, 维护

examples.en: Fyodor wanted to assert his dominance in Rima’s life.
Western Sahara is fighting to assert its independence against Morocco.
The Polisario Front needs to assert control on its liberated zones.

assertion.definition: n. a declaration that is made emphatically (as if no supporting evidence were necessary)
assertion.translation: n. 断言, 主张\n[法] 宣称, 断言, 维护

examples.en: Tom refuted that assertion with a counterexample.
examples.zh: 汤姆用一个反例反驳了那个说法。

assess.definition: v. charge (a person or a property) with a payment, such as a tax or a fine\nv. estimate the value of (property) for taxation
assess.translation: vt. 估定, 对...征税, 评定\n[经] 估计, 估价, 确定(税款罚款等)的金额

examples.en: She can assess investments very accurately.
examples.zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。

examples.en: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
examples.zh: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。

assessment.definition: n. an amount determined as payable\nn. the market value set on assets
assessment.translation: n. 评估, 估定, 评定的款额\n[化] 评估

examples.en: Some experts provided a bleak assessment of Algeria's current situation.
The assessment of communist countries is positive overall.
The art review sounded more like a panegyric than a neutral assessment.

asset.definition: n. a useful or valuable quality
asset.translation: n. 资产, 有益的东西

examples.en: Assets have earning power or some other value to their owner.
examples.zh: 资产盈利能力或一些其他的价值，它们的主人。

examples.en: He has over a million dollars in assets.
examples.zh: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。

examples.en: Trump is a Russian asset.
examples.zh: 川普是俄罗斯的资产。

assign.definition:
v. give out
v. select something or someone for a specific purpose
v. transfer one's right to
v. decide as to where something belongs in a scheme
assign.translation: vt. 分配, 指派, 赋值\n[计] 赋值

examples.en: My boss assigned the hard job to me.
examples.zh: 我老板把艰巨的任务指派给了我。

examples.en: The teacher assigned us ten problems for homework.
examples.zh: 老师给我们布置了十道题为作业。

examples.en: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
examples.zh: 当计数器的数值达到预设的「幸运号码」时，就会显示一则恭喜讯息。

assignment.definition:
n. a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)
n. the instrument by which a claim or right or interest or property is transferred from one person to another
n. the act of distributing something to designated places or persons
n. an undertaking that you have been assigned to do (as by an instructor)
assignment.translation: n. 分配, 功课, 任务, 转让, 归因, 陈述\n[计] 赋值

examples.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
examples.zh: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。

examples.en: It's necessary that we all work together to complete this assignment.
examples.zh: 我们必须一起完成这个任务。

examples.en: I was abroad on an assignment.
examples.zh: 我在国外指派了。

assist.definition: n. (sports) the act of enabling another player to make a good play\nv. act as an assistant in a subordinate or supportive function
assist.translation: n. 帮助, 协助\nvt. 帮助, 促进\nvi. 协助, 参加

examples.en: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
examples.zh: 我想请你帮我整理花园。

examples.en: I'll be able to assist you.
examples.zh: 我能协助你。

examples.en: I'm here to assist you.
examples.zh: 我来协助你。

assistance.definition: n the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose\nn a resource
assistance.translation: n. 协助, 援助\n[经] 援助, 帮助

examples.en: Your assistance is indispensable for us.
examples.zh: 您的帮助对我们来说是必不可少的。

examples.en: Do you need our assistance?
examples.zh: 您需要我们的协助吗？

examples.en: Did you have any assistance?
examples.zh: 你有得到任何协助吗？

assistant.definition: n. a person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
assistant.translation: n. 助手, 助理, 助教\na. 有帮助的, 辅助的, 助理的

examples.en: Old people were tricked by the shop assistant.
examples.zh: 老人被店员骗了。

examples.en: Tom got a job as assistant manager.
examples.zh: 汤姆得到了一份助理经理的工作。

examples.en: I need an assistant who speaks French.
examples.zh: 我需要一个会说法语的助理。

associate.definition:
n. a person who joins with others in some activity or endeavor
n. a person with subordinate membership in a society, institution, or commercial enterprise
n. any event that usually accompanies or is closely connected with another
v. make a logical or causal connection
associate.translation:
n. 同伴, 伙伴, 关联的事物
vt. 使联合, 使发生联系
vi. 交往
[计] 关联

examples.en: Don't associate yourself with people that give up easily.
examples.zh: 别跟轻易放弃的人交往。

examples.en: Don't associate yourself with people that easily give up.
examples.zh: 别跟轻易放弃的人交往。

examples.en: It'd be better if you didn't associate with men like that.
examples.zh: 你最好不要和那样的男人交往。

association.definition:
n. a formal organization of people or groups of people
n. the act of consorting with or joining with others
n. the state of being connected together as in memory or imagination
n. the process of bringing ideas or events together in memory or imagination

examples.en: No one may be compelled to belong to an association.
examples.zh: 不可以强迫任何人加入某个协会。

examples.en: I applied for membership in the association.
examples.zh: 我申请成为协会会员。

examples.en: The association counts thirty members.
examples.zh: 这个协会有三十个会员。

assume.definition:
v. take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof
v. take on titles, offices, duties, responsibilities
v. take on a certain form, attribute, or aspect
v. occupy or take on
assume.translation: vt. 假定, 承担, 呈现\nvi. 装腔作势, 僭越

examples.en: I assume that you wouldn't want to do that.
examples.zh: 我想你不会那么做的吧。

examples.en: Let's assume this is correct for now.
examples.zh: 我们姑且认为它是对的。

examples.en: She assumed that everyone would be for the plan.
examples.zh: 她以为所有人都会赞成计划。

assumption.definition:
n. a hypothesis that is taken for granted
n. the act of taking possession of or power over something
n. celebration in the Roman Catholic Church of the Virgin Mary's being taken up into heaven when her earthly life ended; corresponds to the Dormition in the Eastern Orthodox Church
n. (Christianity) the taking up of the body and soul of the Virgin Mary when her earthly life had ended
assumption.translation: n. 假定, 自负, 担任, 假装\n[经] 假定, 承担

examples.en: That's a pretty big assumption.
examples.zh: 假设得很大。

examples.en: What is the basis of your assumptions?
examples.zh: 您的假设是根据什么?

assurance.definition:
n. freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities
n. a binding commitment to do or give or refrain from something
n. a statement intended to inspire confidence
n. a British term for some kinds of insurance
assurance.translation: n. 保证, 把握, 信心, 保险\n[经] 保证, 担保, 保险

examples.en: She had something of the assurance of a famous actress.
I can give you my personal assurance of that.
You walk with the assurance of one who knows their path.

assure.definition: v. inform positively and with certainty and confidence\nv. assure somebody of the truth of something with the intention of giving the listener confidence
assure.translation: vt. 保证, 使确信, 弄清楚, 担保\n[法] 确信, 保证, 保障

examples.en: I can assure success.
examples.zh: 我可以确保成功。

examples.en: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
examples.zh: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

examples.en: His memory never ceases to astonish me.
examples.zh: 他的记忆力总让我吃惊。

examples.en: We were astonished to hear what had happened.
examples.zh: 我们听到所发生的事，感到很惊讶。

astronaut.definition: n. a person trained to travel in a spacecraft
astronaut.translation: n. 太空旅行者, 宇航员\n[法] 美国太空人

examples.en: The man whom she is going to marry is an astronaut.
examples.zh: 她的未婚夫是一个太空人。

examples.en: She will be the first Japanese woman astronaut.
examples.zh: 她将会成为日本第一个女性太空人。

examples.en: Spacesuits protect astronauts from being injured from impacts of small bits of space dust.
examples.zh: 宇航服保护宇航员们不会因和微小宇宙尘埃碰撞而受伤。

astronomy.definition: n. the branch of physics that studies celestial bodies and the universe as a whole

examples.en: It seems that he is interested in astronomy.
examples.zh: 他好像对天文学挺有兴趣。

examples.en: Astronomy involves the study of stars and planets.
examples.zh: 天文学涉及恒星和行星的研究。

examples.en: Astronomy deals with the stars and planets.
examples.zh: 天文学涉及恒星和行星。

at.definition: n. 100 at equal 1 kip in Laos
at.translation: prep. 在, 向, 对\n[计] 地址转换器, 异常传输, 自动订票

examples.en: I was at a loss as to what to say.
examples.zh: 我无话可说。

examples.en: Mary is at a loss what to say to him.
examples.zh: 玛莉不知道该和他说甚么才好。

examples.en: You work as hard as he did at your age.
examples.zh: 你跟他在你这个年纪时一样努力工作。

athlete.definition: n. a person trained to compete in sports
athlete.translation: n. 运动员, 运动选手\n[医] 运动员

examples.en: That athlete won three times in a row in this tournament.
examples.zh: 那位选手在这次比赛中取得了三连胜。

examples.en: Tom is a natural athlete.
examples.zh: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。

examples.en: BMI categories (underweight, overweight or obese) from general reading table are inappropriate for athletes, children, the elderly, and the infirm.
examples.zh: 总读数表的身高体重指数分类（体重过轻、超重或肥胖）不适用于运动员、儿童、老人和体弱者。

atmosphere.definition:
n. a particular environment or surrounding influence
n. the mass of air surrounding the Earth
n. the weather or climate at some place
n. the envelope of gases surrounding any celestial body
atmosphere.translation: n. 大气, 空气, 气氛\n[医] 大气; 大气压

examples.en: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
examples.zh: 总部里有另外一种气氛。

examples.en: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
examples.zh: 吃火锅的时候 ,气氛往往是非常热闹的.

examples.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
examples.zh: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

atom.definition: n. (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element\nn. (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
atom.translation: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量\n[计] 原子

examples.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 一个水分子是由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成的。

attach.definition: v. cause to be attached\nv. be attached; be in contact with\nv. become attached
attach.translation: vt. 附上, 使依附, 使附属, 使喜爱, 系, 缚\nvi. 附属, 归属, 联系在一起\n[计] 挂接服务器命令, 关联, 挂接, 附加

examples.en: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
examples.zh: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。

examples.en: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
examples.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。

examples.en: Please attach a certificate of quality.
examples.zh: 请附上质量证明书。

attachment.definition: n. a feeling of affection for a person or an institution\nn. a supplementary part or accessory\nn. a writ authorizing the seizure of property that may be needed for the payment of a judgment in a judicial proceeding
attachment.translation: n. 连接, 附属物, 连接物, 爱慕\n[计] 附加, 附件

examples.en: Some cats only form a strong attachment to one human.
According to Buddhism, the primary cause of suffering is attachment.
Yanni must have experienced separation from a major attachment figure.

attack.definition:
n. (military) an offensive against an enemy (using weapons)
n. an offensive move in a sport or game
n. the act of attacking
n. a decisive manner of beginning a musical tone or phrase
attack.translation: n. 攻击, 抨击\nvt. 攻击, 抨击, 动手干\nvi. 攻击

examples.en: He died of a heart attack on the stage.
examples.zh: 他是在舞台上心脏病发死的。

examples.en: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
examples.zh: 敌人对那栋建筑物使出了强力攻击。

examples.en: Tom had a heart attack last year.
examples.zh: 汤姆去年得了心脏病。

attain.definition:
v to gain with effort
v reach a point in time, or a certain state or level
v find unexpectedly
v reach a destination, either real or abstract
attain.translation: vt. 达到, 获得\nvi. 达到

examples.en: That aim is impossible to attain.
examples.zh: 那个目标是无法达成的。

examples.en: His music has attained great popularity overseas.
examples.zh: 他的音乐在国外很受欢迎。

examples.en: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
examples.zh: 靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。

attainment.definition: n. the act of achieving an aim\nn. arrival at a new stage

examples.en: He taught contemplation as a means of spiritual purification and the attainment of the Dao, a principle that signifies the highest spiritual ideals of mankind.
examples.zh: 他为精神的洁净和获得道的方法教深思，道是表示人类最高的精神理想的一个原则。

attempt.definition: n. earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
attempt.translation: n. 尝试, 企图\nvt. 尝试, 企图

examples.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
examples.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。

examples.en: They explored every avenue in an attempt to avoid war.
examples.zh: 他们尽一切手段避免战争。

examples.en: I made no attempt to make friends with her.
examples.zh: 我没打算和她做朋友。

attend.definition:
v. be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
v. take charge of or deal with
v. to accompany as a circumstance or follow as a result
v. give heed (to)
attend.translation: vt. 参加, 照料, 伴随\nvi. 专心于, 照顾, 服侍, 出席

examples.en: Like it or not, we have to attend that meeting.
examples.zh: 不管喜不喜欢，我们都得参加那个会议。

examples.en: It is not necessary for us to attend the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们没有必要参加会议。

examples.en: It is not necessary for us to attend this lecture.
examples.zh: 我们没有必要出席这个讲座。

attendance.definition: n. the act of being present (at a meeting or event etc.)\nn. the frequency with which a person is present\nn. the number of people that are present
attendance.translation: n. 出席, 出席的人数, 照料\n[法] 管理, 照料, 资助

examples.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members.
examples.zh: 全员均须出席。

examples.en: Firstly, let's check the attendance.
examples.zh: 首先，我们检查出勤情况。

attention.definition:
n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others
n. a general interest that leads people to want to know more
n. a courteous act indicating affection
n. the faculty or power of mental concentration
attention.translation: n. 注意, 注意力\n[计] 引起注意信号

examples.en: You should pay more attention to what he says.
examples.zh: 你应该多注意他说的话。

examples.en: You should pay more attention to what you say.
examples.zh: 你应该更注意你说的话。

examples.en: Give your whole attention to what you are doing.
examples.zh: 请专心做你正在做的事情。

attitude.definition: n. a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways\nn. a theatrical pose created for effect\nn. position of aircraft or spacecraft relative to a frame of reference (the horizon or direction of motion)
attitude.translation: n. 态度, 看法, 姿势\n[医] 体态, 姿势, 态度

examples.en: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
examples.zh: 抱著失败主义的态度你无法打一场漂亮的仗。

examples.en: This shows that happiness and sadness are only separated by attitude.
examples.zh: 这表明幸福和悲痛之间只隔着看法。

examples.en: I hope to improve my attitude to work.
examples.zh: 我希望改进自己的工作态度。

attorney.definition: n a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
attorney.translation: n. 代理人, 律师\n[经] 律师, 代理人

examples.en: It's totally without precedent for the suspect's attorney to be the true culprit.
examples.zh: 这前所未闻, 犯罪嫌疑人的律师竟然是真正的罪魁祸首。

examples.en: Does Tom have an attorney?
examples.zh: 汤姆有请律师吗？

attract.definition: v. direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes\nv. be attractive to\nv. exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it from moving away
attract.translation: vt. 吸引, 诱惑\nvi. 有吸引力

examples.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
examples.zh: 第一个吸引我注意的科目是哲学。

examples.en: This app attracts over 10,000 users each day who engage with its features.
examples.zh: 这个应用程式每日吸引超过一万位使用者使用其功能。

examples.en: Black Friday sales attract shoppers.
examples.zh: 黑色星期五促销活动吸引了许多购物者。

attraction.definition:
n. the force by which one object attracts another
n. an entertainment that is offered to the public
n. the quality of arousing interest; being attractive or something that attracts
n. a characteristic that provides pleasure and attracts
attraction.translation: n. 吸引, 吸引人的事物, 吸引力\n[医] 吸引

examples.en: The tickets for this attraction can only be bought online.
examples.zh: 这个景点只能网上购票。

examples.en: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
examples.zh: 珊瑚礁是这个地区的主要景点。

examples.en: Edinburgh already offers a busy and traditional city experience, with many historic buildings and tourist attractions.
examples.zh: 爱丁堡已经供应一个繁忙而传统的城市，有许多历史性的建筑物和名胜。

attractive.definition: a. pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm\ns. having power to arouse interest\na. having the properties of a magnet; the ability to draw or pull;
attractive.translation: a. 吸引人的, 有魅力的\n[法] 有吸引力的, 有迷惑力的

examples.en: Mary has as attractive a personality as her sister.
examples.zh: 玛丽性格很好，就像她姐姐一样。

examples.en: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
examples.zh: 她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。

examples.en: Tokyo is the least attractive town to me.
examples.zh: 我最不感兴趣的城市就是东京。

attribute.definition: n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity
attribute.translation: n. 属性, 标志, 定语\nvt. 把...归于, 认为...属于\n[计] 属性

examples.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
examples.zh: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。

examples.en: Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.
examples.zh: 能解释为愚蠢的，就不要解释为恶意。

examples.en: He attributed his success to good luck.
examples.zh: 他把他的成功归功于好运。

auction.definition: n. a variety of bridge in which tricks made in excess of the contract are scored toward game; now generally superseded by contract bridge\nn. the public sale of something to the highest bidder\nv. sell at an auction

examples.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.
examples.zh: 无人领取的物品被拍卖了。

examples.en: The unclaimed items were sold at auction.
examples.zh: 无人领取的物品被拍卖了。

examples.en: The unclaimed items were auctioned off.
examples.zh: 无人领取的物品被拍卖了。

audience.definition: n. a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance\nn. the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment
audience.translation: n. 听众, 观众, 读者\n[法] 听讼, 观众, 听众

examples.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
examples.zh: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。

examples.en: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.
examples.zh: 所有的观众都站起来鼓掌。

examples.en: His speech won the immediate applause of the audience.
examples.zh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。

audio.definition: n. the audible part of a transmitted signal\nn. an audible acoustic wave frequency\nn. the sound elements of television
audio.translation: a. 音频的, 声音的\n[电] 声频

examples.en: Audio in Tatoeba sentences are provided by Shtooka.
examples.zh: Tatoeba句子的音频是由Shtooka所提供。

examples.en: How do I contribute audio in Tatoeba?
examples.zh: 我如何在Tatoeba贡献音频?

examples.en: The audio feature is only available in some sentences in Chinese, Dutch, French, German and Shanghainese.
examples.zh: 音频功能仅适用在某些语言的句子中，如中文，荷兰语，法语，德语和上海话。

audit.definition: n. a methodical examination or review of a condition or situation\nv. examine carefully for accuracy with the intent of verification\nv. attend academic courses without getting credit
audit.translation:
n. 审计, 查帐
vt. 查(帐), 旁听
vi. 查账
[计] 查帐; 审查; 检查

examples.en: Bangladesh Bank's policy making is based on the audit report.
This financial audit also includes an evaluation of the company's assets.
The audit team interviewed staff and did a walkthrough of the offices.

August.definition: n. the month following July and preceding September\ns. of or befitting a lord\ns. profoundly honored
August.translation: n. 八月\na. 威严的, 令人敬畏的

examples.en: She said she will go to Paris in August.
examples.zh: 她对我说8月去巴黎。

examples.en: She told me that she would go to Paris in August.
examples.zh: 她跟我说八月份她会去巴黎。

examples.en: Where were you in August last year?
examples.zh: 去年八月份你在哪儿？

aunt.definition: n. the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle
aunt.translation: n. 阿姨, 姨妈, 舅妈, 姑妈, 伯母

examples.en: I ran into my aunt by chance in Europe.
examples.zh: 我在欧洲偶遇了姑母。

examples.en: My aunt made a new skirt for me.
examples.zh: 我阿姨做了一条新裙子给我。

examples.en: This doll is a gift from my aunt.
examples.zh: 这个洋娃娃是婶婶给我的礼物。

authentic.definition: s. conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief\ns. not counterfeit or copied
authentic.translation: a. 可靠的, 可信的, 真正的\n[法] 被认证的, 确认的, 可信的

examples.en: I really hope that I can speak authentic Chinese.
examples.zh: 我很希望可以说一口地道的中文。

examples.en: Are there authentic Chinese restaurants in France?
examples.zh: 法国有正宗的中餐吗？

examples.en: Following a wave of other recent sports simulations, this release offers ball game fans a more authentic management experience.
examples.zh: 在多款体育类模拟游戏陆续登场后，这款作品为热爱球类运动的玩家带来更真实的管理体验。

author.translation: n. 作家, 作家的著作, 创始人\n[法] 作者, 著作人, 本人

examples.en: Euclid was the author of the first book on mathematics.
examples.zh: 欧几里得是第一本数学著作的作者。

examples.en: The author translated the fairy tale into our mother tongue.
examples.zh: 作者将童话翻译成了我们的母语。

examples.en: This is the room where the author killed himself.
examples.zh: 这就是那个作家自杀的房间。

authority.definition:
n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions
n. (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others
n. an expert whose views are taken as definitive
n. official permission or approval
authority.translation: n. 权力, 当权者, 当局, 权威, 专家\n[经] 代理权, 授权, 权威

examples.en: The doctor is a great authority on children's diseases.
examples.zh: 那位医生是儿童疾病的专家。

examples.en: On what authority are you making us go?
examples.zh: 凭什么让我们走？

examples.en: He gave me authority to fire them.
examples.zh: 他授权给我解雇了他们。

authorize.definition: v. grant authorization or clearance for
authorize.translation: vt. 授权, 批准, 委托\n[经] 授权, 委任, 认可

examples.en: You are not authorized to enter there.
examples.zh: 你无权进入那里。

examples.en: Is it true that you authorized the driver to take the car home?
examples.zh: 你批准司机把车开回家的事是真的吗？

automatic.definition: a. operating with minimal human intervention; independent of external control\ns. resembling the unthinking functioning of a machine\ns. without volition or conscious control
automatic.translation: n. 自动手枪, 自动机械\na. 自动的, 机械的, 必然的, 无意识的

examples.en: The girl, her eyes shining brightly from that single hint, makes her cute cat-motif automatic pencil run across her notebook.
examples.zh: 这女孩的眼睛闪烁著光亮, 这个暗示让她可爱的猫图案自动铅笔越过了她的笔记本。

examples.en: He got killed in an automobile accident.
examples.zh: 他因交通事故死亡。

examples.en: She was killed in an automobile accident.
examples.zh: 她死于一场汽车车祸。

examples.en: Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.
examples.zh: 自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。

autonomous.definition: s. (of political bodies) not controlled by outside forces\ns. existing as an independent entity\ns. (of persons) free from external control and constraint in e.g. action and judgment
autonomous.translation: a. 自治的\n[医] 自主的

examples.en: There aren't many Jews left in the Jewish Autonomous Oblast.
The population of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic (NAR) has increased.
The German army is aiming to develop deadly, autonomous weapons systems.

autumn.definition: n the season when the leaves fall from the trees

examples.en: In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
examples.zh: 有些动物会在秋天为冬季储藏食物。

examples.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
examples.zh: 这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。

examples.en: Which season do you like best, spring or autumn?
examples.zh: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？

available.definition: a. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service\ns. not busy; not otherwise committed\ns. convenient for use or disposal
available.translation: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的\n[医] 有效的, 可得的

examples.en: The dictionary he talked about isn't available in the library.
examples.zh: 他说的词典图书馆没有.

examples.en: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
examples.zh: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。

examples.en: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.
examples.zh: 计算机产业能够提供相当多的就业岗位。

avenue.definition: n. a line of approach\nn. a wide street or thoroughfare
avenue.translation: n. 大街, 途径, 林荫路

examples.en: They explored every avenue in an attempt to avoid war.
examples.zh: 他们尽一切手段避免战争。

examples.en: I like shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在纽约第五大街购物。

examples.en: I'd like to do shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
examples.zh: 我想在纽约的第五大道购物。

average.definition:
n. a statistic describing the location of a distribution
n. (sports) the ratio of successful performances to opportunities
n. an intermediate scale value regarded as normal or usual
v. amount to or come to an average, without loss or gain
average.translation:
n. 平均, 平均数, 一般水平, 海损
a. 平均的, 中等的, 平常的
vt. 算出...平均数, 平均做, 均分, 使平衡
vi. 平均为, 呈中间色

examples.en: How many times a minute does the average person blink?
examples.zh: 人平均一分钟眨几次眼睛？

examples.en: Europeans drink, on average, 12.5 liters of pure alcohol per year.
examples.zh: 欧洲人每年平均饮用十二点五公升的纯酒精。

examples.en: The average height of the girls in class is over 155 centimeters.
examples.zh: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。

aviation.definition: n. the aggregation of a country's military aircraft\nn. the operation of aircraft to provide transportation\nn. the art of operating aircraft
aviation.translation: n. 航空, 航空学, 飞行术\n[法] 航空, 飞行, 飞行术

examples.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
examples.zh: 航空专家详细分析了统计数据。

avoid.definition: v. stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something\nv. refrain from doing something
avoid.translation: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消\n[法] 避免, 回避, 躲开

examples.en: We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.
examples.zh: 我们黎明时起床以避开交通堵塞。

examples.en: So as to avoid being late, we went by car.
examples.zh: 我们乘车去以免迟到

examples.en: I want to avoid phones that have too many issues.
examples.zh: 我想要避免问题太多的手机。

awake.definition: a. not in a state of sleep; completely conscious
awake.translation: a. 醒着的\nvt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到\nvi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到

examples.en: When the sisters came back, their mother was still awake.
examples.zh: 在姐妹们回来的时候，她们的妈妈还醒着。

examples.en: Last night my house was robbed while I was still awake.
examples.zh: 昨晚我还没有睡觉家里就被小偷光顾了

examples.en: You think you're awake, but you may, in fact, be dreaming.
examples.zh: 你以为自己醒着，但其实你可能是在做梦。

award.definition:
n. a grant made by a law court
n. a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction
v. give, especially as an honor or reward
v. give as judged due or on the basis of merit
award.translation: n. 奖品, 裁定, 判决\nvt. 授予, 给予

examples.en: In addition, we will issue the 'employee of the month' award afterwards.
examples.zh: 另外，之后我们会颁发“每月最佳员工”奖。

examples.en: He was awarded a grant to study in Germany.
examples.zh: 他获得了一份去德国留学的奖学金。

examples.en: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.
examples.zh: 他们在画展上授予了她一等奖。

aware.definition: a. (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
aware.translation: a. 知道的, 有觉悟的

examples.en: Are you aware of how much she loves you?
examples.zh: 你知道她有多么爱你吗?

examples.en: I became aware of someone looking at me.
examples.zh: 我感觉到有人在看著我。

examples.en: I'm sure they're all aware of what happened.
examples.zh: 他们一定意识到发生什么事了。

awareness.definition: n. having knowledge of\nn. state of elementary or undifferentiated consciousness
awareness.translation: n. 意识, 认识\n[计] 识别, 议定, 明白

examples.en: April 2nd is World Autism Awareness Day.
examples.zh: 4月2日是世界提高自闭症意识日。

examples.en: It takes time to develop political awareness.
examples.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。

examples.en: Developing political awareness takes time.
examples.zh: 培养政治意识要花费时间。

away.definition:
s. not present; having left
a. used of an opponent's ground
s. (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter
r. from a particular thing or place or position (`forth' is obsolete)

examples.en: Please take care of my dog while I am away.
examples.zh: 麻烦在我离开的时候帮忙照顾我的狗。

examples.en: As soon as he saw a policeman, he ran away.
examples.zh: 他一看见警察就逃走了。

examples.en: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.
examples.zh: 老婆叫我把这顶旧帽子丢掉。

awesome.definition: s inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
awesome.translation: a. 引起敬畏的, 可怕的

examples.en: This room's pretty awesome, eh?
examples.zh: 这个房间太棒了，难道不是么？

examples.en: Your Chinese is awesome already.
examples.zh: 你的中文已经登峰造极了。

examples.en: This application is awesome.
examples.zh: 这个应用好极了。

awful.definition: s. causing fear or dread or terror
awful.translation: a. 可怕的, 庄严的, 虔敬的

examples.en: When I try to walk, I get an awful pain here.
examples.zh: 我一走路，这里就很痛。

examples.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
examples.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。

examples.en: What an awful lot of books you have!
examples.zh: 你的书真是多到可怕啊!

awkward.definition:
s. causing inconvenience
a. lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance
s. difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
s. not elegant or graceful in expression
awkward.translation: a. 笨拙的, 棘手的

examples.en: The girl made an awkward bow.
examples.zh: 这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

examples.en: He is awkward in his movements.
examples.zh: 他笨手笨脚的。

examples.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.
examples.zh: 柏霖昨天在夜市遇到前女友，尴尬到不行。

axis.definition:
n. a straight line through a body or figure that satisfies certain conditions
n. the main stem or central part about which plant organs or plant parts such as branches are arranged
n. in World War II the alliance of Germany and Italy in 1936 which later included Japan and other nations
n. the 2nd cervical vertebra; serves as a pivot for turning the head

examples.en: The earth revolves on its axis once every 24 hours.
examples.zh: 地球每二十四小时就会绕轴自转一周。

abode.definition:
n any address at which you dwell more than temporarily
n housing that someone is living in
v dwell
v put up with something or somebody unpleasant
abode.translation: n. 住所, 住处\nabide的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: "Himalaya" means "abode of snow".
examples.zh: 「喜马拉雅」的意思是「雪之居所」。

abolition.definition: n. the act of abolishing a system or practice or institution (especially abolishing slavery)
abolition.translation: n. 废除, 废奴运动\n[医] 禁止, 消失

examples.en: He lobbied for the abolition of the death penalty.
He advocated for the abolition of the death penalty.
The abolition of slavery in Europe eventually reached America.

aboriginal.definition: a. of or pertaining to members of the indigenous people of Australia\ns. having existed from the beginning; in an earliest or original stage or state
aboriginal.translation: a. 原始的, 土著的\nn. 土著居民, 土生生物

examples.en: Aboriginal people are not treated as well as white people.
Aboriginal Australians are among the most jailed people on earth.
Aboriginal Australians make up about 3 per cent of the population.

abound.definition: v. be abundant or plentiful; exist in large quantities\nv. be in a state of movement or action
abound.translation: vi. 大量存在, 富于, 充满

examples.en: Fish abound in this lake.
examples.zh: 这湖里有许多鱼。

examples.en: That country abounds in oil.
examples.zh: 该国盛产石油。

examples.en: The island abounds with rivers.
examples.zh: 那岛上有很多河。

abrasion.definition: n. an abraded area where the skin is torn or worn off\nn. erosion by friction
abrasion.translation: n. 磨擦, 磨损, 磨损处\n[化] 磨耗; 磨蚀
