examples.en: An adjustable wrench is a useful tool for any plumber.
Ziri asked Yazid if he could borrow his adjustable wrench.
The water cooled, tilting towards the adjustable 45 degree mirror.

admiration.definition: n. a feeling of delighted approval and liking\nn. a favorable judgment
admiration.translation: n. 赞赏, 钦佩, 引人赞赏的对象

examples.en: All of a sudden I'm filled with great admiration for you!
examples.zh: 我瞬间对你肃然起敬！

examples.en: Ignorance is the mother of fear as well as of admiration.
examples.zh: 无知是恐惧之母，也是崇拜之母。

examples.en: I had great admiration for his generosity.
examples.zh: 我很钦佩他的慷慨大方。

advantageous.definition: a. giving an advantage\ns. appropriate for achieving a particular end; implies a lack of concern for fairness
advantageous.translation: a. 有利的, 有益的

examples.en: Being able to use a computer is advantageous.
examples.zh: 会用电脑是一个好处。

advisable.definition: a. worthy of being recommended or suggested; prudent or wise
advisable.translation: a. 适当的, 明智的

examples.en: It is not advisable to try and eat a crayon.
It's advisable to bring an umbrella in case of rain.
It's not advisable to wear a miniskirt to a funeral.

aeroplane.definition: n an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets

examples.en: The sky was filled with aeroplanes.
examples.zh: 天上满是飞机。

examples.en: Tom likes making paper aeroplanes.
examples.zh: 汤姆喜欢折纸飞机。

affective.translation: a. 情感的, 表达感情的\n[医] 感情的, 情感的

examples.en: Be careful! Affective dependency is not synonym for love!
Around two to four per cent of Canadians suffer from Seasonal Affective Disorder.

agitation.definition: n. a mental state of extreme emotional disturbance\nn. a state of agitation or turbulent change or development\nn. the feeling of being agitated; not calm
agitation.translation: n. 激动, 焦虑, 煽动, 搅动, 摇动\n[化] 搅拌; 搅拌作用

examples.en: His agitation was so great that he could hardly speak.
Her agitation was so great that she could hardly speak.
Sami was hopeful that Layla's agitation might be subsiding.

agreeable.definition: a. conforming to your own liking or feelings or nature\ns. prepared to agree or consent
agreeable.translation: a. 令人愉快的, 同意的\n[医] 佳适的

examples.en: He is an agreeable person.
examples.zh: 他是个好脾气的人。

examples.en: She has an agreeable voice.
examples.zh: 她的声音令人愉快。

alas.definition: n a flat wing-shaped process or winglike part of an organism\nn a wing of an insect\nr by bad luck

examples.en: Many of our pioneers are still alive... but, alas, many of them aren't alive any more.
examples.zh: 我们的先驱者中许多还活著...但是，唉，其中有许多已经死了。

alignment.definition: n. the spatial property possessed by an arrangement or position of things in a straight line or in parallel lines\nn. the act of adjusting or aligning the parts of a device in relation to each other
alignment.translation: n. 队列, 结盟, 校正\n[计] 校准; 对齐; 对准

examples.en: The engineer measured the axial alignment of the rotating shaft.
Why can't I edit the vertical alignment in LO Base form?
My side mirror is out of alignment.

allied.definition:
s. related by common characteristics or ancestry
a. of or relating to or denoting the Allies in World War II
a. of or relating to or denoting the Allies in World War I
s. united in a confederacy or league
allied.translation: a. 联盟的, 联姻的, 联系起来的

examples.en: Germany was allied with Italy in World War II.
examples.zh: 在二战中，德国与意大利结盟。

examples.en: Germany was once allied with Italy.
examples.zh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。

aloud.definition: r. using the voice; not silently
aloud.translation: adv. 出声地, 大声地

examples.en: He thought to himself, "No!" Aloud he said, "Yes."
examples.zh: 他心里对自己说“不！”。他大声说出“是。”。

examples.en: I'd like Tom to read what's written on that paper aloud.
examples.zh: 请汤姆大声朗读纸上的内容。

examples.en: Tom read the letter aloud.
examples.zh: 汤姆大声念出了那封信。

alteration.definition: n. the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)
alteration.translation: n. 变更, 改动\n[医] 变更

examples.en: That ship was towed into the shipyard to undergo alterations.
The sales plan allows of no alteration.
The plan is incapable of alteration.

aluminium.definition: n a silvery ductile metallic element found primarily in bauxite

examples.en: Is your bike frame made of steel or aluminium?
Aluminium doesn't conduct electricity as well as copper does.
Aluminium doesn't conduct electricity as well as copper.

amends.definition:
n a sum of money paid in compensation for loss or injury
n something done or paid in expiation of a wrong
v make amendments to
v to make better
v set straight or right

examples.en: It's never too late to make amends.
examples.zh: 弥补永远不会太晚。

ampere.definition: n. a former unit of electric current (slightly smaller than the SI ampere)\nn. the basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

examples.en: Electric current is measured in amperes.
Ampere per meter is the SI unit of magnetic field strength. Its symbol is A/m.
Meter, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, and candela are the fundamental units of the metric system.

amplitude.definition: n. (physics) the maximum displacement of a periodic wave\nn. the property of copious abundance\nn. greatness of magnitude
amplitude.translation: n. 广阔, 充足, 幅度\n[化] 振幅

examples.en: We perceive the amplitude of a sound wave as loudness.
We perceive the amplitude of a light wave as brightness.
The mean value of the frequency decreases with increasing amplitude.

amusement.definition: n. a feeling of delight at being entertained
amusement.translation: n. 兴味, 娱乐, 消遣\n[法] 娱乐, 娱乐活动

examples.en: There are not many amusements in the village.
examples.zh: 村里没啥娱乐活动。

analogous.definition: s. similar or equivalent in some respects though otherwise dissimilar\na. corresponding in function but not in evolutionary origin
analogous.translation: a. 类似的, 相似的\n[医] 类似的, 类同的

examples.en: The human heart is analogous to a pump.
In the economic sphere communism is analogous to democracy in the political sphere.
Your situation is analogous to mine.

analogue.definition: n. something having the property of being analogous to something else\na. of a circuit or device having an output that is proportional to the input
analogue.translation: n. 类似物, 相似情况\n[医] 类似物, 同型物, 相似器官, 同功异质体

examples.en: The shop sold analogue and digital clocks.
This hyperbola is important to us. It's the relativistic analogue of a circle.
She had an analogue watch.

analytical.definition: a using or skilled in using analysis (i.e., separating a whole--intellectual or substantial--into its elemental parts or basic principles)\na of a proposition that is necessarily true independent of fact or experience
analytical.translation: a. 分析的, 善于分析的, 解析的\n[机] 分析的

examples.en: Can we use Scientific calculators on the analytical chemistry test?
René Descartes is the father of analytical thinking.
Heuristics is a search performed through analytical reasoning.

angel.definition: n. spiritual being attendant upon God\nn. invests in a theatrical production\nn. the highest waterfall; has more than one leap; flow varies seasonally
angel.translation: n. 天使, 守护神, 善人

examples.en: My mother was an angel and an inspiration to me.
examples.zh: 我的母亲是一位天使，也是我的灵感来源。

examples.en: Music is well said to be the speech of angels.
examples.zh: 人们说得好，音乐是天使的话语。

examples.en: This morning, I saw an angel.
examples.zh: 我今晨看见一位天使。

announcer.definition: n. someone who proclaims a message publicly\nn. reads news, commercials on radio or television
announcer.translation: n. 节目报告员, 宣告者

examples.en: I want to become a TV announcer in the future.
His ambition was to break into television as an announcer.
Even the stadium's PA announcer couldn't whip up the atmosphere.

annually.translation: adv. 一年一次, 每年\n[经] 年度的, 每年的

examples.en: Do you know how many people starve to death in the world annually?
examples.zh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

examples.en: The Nobel Prize is awarded annually on December 10, the day of Alfred Nobel's death.
examples.zh: 诺贝尔奖在每年的十二月十日颁发，是Alfred Nobel去世的那天。

anode.definition: n. a positively charged electrode by which electrons leave an electrical device\nn. the negatively charged terminal of a voltaic cell or storage battery that supplies current
anode.translation: n. 阳极\n[化] 阳极; 正极

examples.en: Tom doesn't understand the difference between a cathode and an anode.

antarctic.definition: n. the region around the south pole: Antarctica and surrounding waters
antarctic.translation: a. 南极的, 南极地带的\nn. 南极地区

examples.en: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.
examples.zh: 他们出发去南极探险。

examples.en: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
examples.zh: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。

antisocial.definition: s. shunning contact with others; just shy"\ns. hostile to or disruptive of normal standards of social behavior
antisocial.translation: 不爱社交的, 反社会的, 有害于公众利益的\n[医] 不喜社交的

examples.en: I may be antisocial, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.
examples.zh: 我或许不善于社交,但这并不意味我不和别人交谈。

appreciable.definition: s. enough to be estimated or measured
appreciable.translation: a. 可感知的, 可评估的

examples.en: There was no appreciable quantity of mercury found in the fish.
He's shown no appreciable change of attitude.

approximately.definition: r. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
approximately.translation: adv. 大约, 大致, 近于\n[经] 大约, 近似

examples.en: Sami called at approximately six.
examples.zh: 萨米六点左右打来。

examples.en: Approximately thirty people were arrested.
examples.zh: 大约 30 个人被逮捕。

examples.en: Approximately thirty young people attended.
examples.zh: 约有三十个年轻人到了。

arctic.definition: n. the regions to the north of the Arctic Circle centered on the North Pole\nn. a waterproof overshoe that protects shoes from water or snow\ns. extremely cold
arctic.translation: a. 北极的, 极寒的\nn. 北极圈, 北极

examples.en: A few months later they return to their breeding grounds in the Arctic.
examples.zh: 数月后，牠们回到了北极的繁殖地。

examples.en: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
examples.zh: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。

ash.definition:
n. the residue that remains when something is burned
n. any of various deciduous pinnate-leaved ornamental or timber trees of the genus Fraxinus
n. strong elastic wood of any of various ash trees; used for furniture and tool handles and sporting goods such as baseball bats
v. convert into ashes
ash.translation: n. 灰, 灰烬\n[化] 灰分

examples.en: The big fire reduced the whole town to ashes.
examples.zh: 那场大火把整个小镇烧成了灰烬。

examples.en: Grandmother's ashes are in an urn at the temple.
examples.zh: 祖母的骨灰在寺院的骨灰瓮里。

examples.en: That fire burned the entire town to ashes.
examples.zh: 那场大火把整个小镇烧成了灰烬。

ass.definition: n. a pompous fool\nn. hardy and sure-footed animal smaller and with longer ears than the horse
ass.translation: n. 驴, 傻瓜, 笨蛋, 屁股\n[计] 模拟仿真系统

examples.en: It's such a pain in the ass.
examples.zh: 烦死人。

examples.en: I don't give a rat's ass.
examples.zh: 我完全不管。

examples.en: Shove a stick up your ass.
examples.zh: 把一根棍子塞进你的屁股里。

assertive.translation: a. 武断的, 过分自信的\n[法] 断言的

examples.en: Tom told me that he thought Mary was too assertive.
Tom told me he thought that Mary was too assertive.
Tom didn't seem to be as assertive as Mary.

assimilation.definition: n. the state of being assimilated; people of different backgrounds come to see themselves as part of a larger national family\nn. the social process of absorbing one cultural group into harmony with another\nn. the process of absorbing nutrients into the body after digestion
assimilation.translation: n. 同化, 同化作用, 吸收\n[化] 同化; 同化作用

examples.en: Algerians don't want cultural assimilation with Western nations.
Mountain and desert Berbers resisted assimilation.
Many Russian Jews speak Russian today instead of Yiddish due to assimilation under the Soviet Union.

astonishment.definition: n. the feeling that accompanies something extremely surprising
astonishment.translation: n. 惊异, 惊愕, 使人惊异的事物

examples.en: To my astonishment, my money was gone.
examples.zh: 令我惊讶的是，我的钱没了。

aural.definition: a. of or pertaining to hearing or the ear\na. relating to or characterized by an aura
aural.translation: a. 耳的, 听觉的, 气氛的, 气味的, 光环的\n[医] 耳的; 先兆的

examples.en: Good day, lords. In what way can I refine upon my adroitness in aural comprehension?
examples.zh: 早安，师傅。我应该怎么样提高听力能力？

automatically.translation: adv. 自动地, 机械地

examples.en: If you press this button the window opens automatically.
examples.zh: 按下这个按钮, 窗口会自动打开。

examples.en: Tom was automatically logged out of Tatoeba.
examples.zh: 汤姆自动退出了Tatoeba。

examples.en: All plans automatically renew until cancelled.
examples.zh: 所有订阅将自动续订，除非使用者主动取消。

automation.definition: n. the act of implementing the control of equipment with advanced technology; usually involving electronic hardware\nn. the condition of being automatically operated or controlled\nn. equipment used to achieve automatic control or operation
automation.translation: n. 自动化, 自动操作\n[计] 自动学; 自动化

examples.en: This form of automation began with the arrival of the computer.
Automation sometimes deskills workers by removing complex decisions from their jobs.
Automation is bound to have important social consequences.

awfully.definition: r used as intensifiers\nr of a dreadful kind\nr in a terrible manner
awfully.translation: adv. 恶劣地, 非常地, 极端地

examples.en: He was tired out by an awfully tough job.
examples.zh: 他被一件辛苦的工作累坏了。

examples.en: I'm awfully sorry that I was late.
examples.zh: 非常抱歉，我迟到了。

examples.en: I was awfully confused by his question.
examples.zh: 我对他的问题感到非常困惑。

ax.definition: n. an edge tool with a heavy bladed head mounted across a handle\nv. terminate
ax.translation: n. 斧头\nvt. 用斧削或砍, 削减

examples.en: The tree was felled with one hard blow of his ax.
examples.zh: 他用斧头重重的斩了一下，那棵树就倒了下来。

axial.definition: a. of or relating to or resembling an axis of rotation\ns. situated on or along or in the direction of an axis
axial.translation: a. 轴的, 成轴的, 轴向的\n[医] 轴的, 中轴的

examples.en: The engineer measured the axial alignment of the rotating shaft.
The colony's habitat ring rotated at just the right axial speed to simulate Earth gravity.
But computerized axial tomography, better known as a helical CT scan, provided doctors with far greater detail.

axle.definition: n. a shaft on which a wheel rotates
axle.translation: n. 轴, 车轴\n[电] 轴

examples.en: The axle of the car wobbled and would soon cause further damage.
When I started to fix the language, I got wrapped around the axle.
The axle is out of true.
